events.title: Ouranos, the descent and the formation of the Guild
events.when: Almost a thousand years before the SO02 narrative, in its historical account.
events.changes: The tower contains monster emergence; the alliance is reorganized as the Guild.
events.knowledge: Historical narration; not evidence every present-day character knows this account.
events.uncertainty: No ordering against every other ancient legend is established.
events.frame: SO02 historical exposition during the current investigation

events.title: Albert’s legendary last battle precedes the gods’ descent
events.when: Ancient heroic era; shortly before the divine descent in Bell’s later account.
events.changes: Albert dies after taking the dragon’s eye and driving it away.
events.knowledge: Bell reads and relates the legend in FM16, not at the ancient occurrence.
events.uncertainty: This does not establish an exact millennium date or Bell’s knowledge of Aiz’s parentage.

events.title: Aria’s legendary adventures belong to the Ancient Times
events.when: Over one thousand years ago, according to the story discussed in SO03.
events.changes: Historical narrative connects a fairy with a multiracial hero party.
events.knowledge: Lefiya considers then rejects a connection; her conjecture is not full knowledge of Aiz’s parentage.
events.uncertainty: Aiz’s precise birth date and the mechanism joining ancient and current chronology remain unresolved.
events.frame: Current characters reading and discussing an ancient story

events.title: Finn loses his parents and chooses his new name
events.when: Attack in the year he turns ten; name and resolve chosen at the following dawn.
events.changes: His parents die protecting him; Deimne adopts Finn and resolves to become a light for prums.
events.uncertainty: Age and local overnight sequence do not independently establish thirty-two years before Bell.

events.title: Loki descends and visits a village before recruiting Finn
events.when: The first village visit is half a day after descent.
events.changes: Loki is in the lower world before her first follower.
events.knowledge: No later Familia members receive this memory merely because the reader sees it.
events.uncertainty: No exact calendar date or exhaustive participant knowledge asserted.

events.title: Finn becomes Loki’s first follower
events.when: Before Riveria and Gareth join; exact year not assigned.
events.changes: Loki Familia formally begins with Finn in a village outside Orario.
events.uncertainty: No age subtraction is used to invent a founding year.
events.frame: SO14 founding recollection framed by the Level Seven celebration

events.title: Riveria and Aina leave the elven forest
events.when: Three days after Riveria decides to leave, before the founding trio’s vow.
events.changes: Both depart; Aina is named Lindle at this point.
events.uncertainty: Do not backdate Aina’s later married name or infer an exact twenty-eight-year date.

events.title: The founding trio makes its shared vow
events.when: After Riveria and Gareth have joined Loki’s party.
events.changes: Three distinct ambitions become a shared pledge.
events.knowledge: Aina witnesses and declines joining this particular vow.
events.uncertainty: Aina’s refusal concerns the vow, not a demonstrated refusal of Falna. Her lifetime membership history remains unproven.
events.frame: SO14 remembered founding journey, not the contemporary celebration

events.title: Zeus and Hera defeat two great beasts, lose to the Black Dragon and are expelled
events.arc: History — fall of the old powers
events.when: Fifteen years before Hermes’s FM06 account; beast battles and expulsion are sequential stages.
events.changes: Old dominant Familias lose their strongest forces; Loki and Freya supplant them.
events.knowledge: Hermes tells Bell this historical account in FM06; Bell does not thereby learn his own ancestry.
events.uncertainty: Dates within the campaign and delay to expulsion are not separately fixed.
events.frame: Hermes recounts history to Bell during FM06

events.title: Dionysus begins planning Orario’s destruction after Zeus and Hera fall
events.when: Fifteen years before SO12, from Zeus and Hera’s downfall; concrete preparations follow later.
events.changes: Dionysus develops a plan aimed at eliminating potential heroes as well as breaking Orario, so survivors cannot quickly rebuild its defenses.
events.knowledge: This purpose is disclosed to Loki only during the final SO12 confrontation; it is not public knowledge fifteen years earlier.
events.uncertainty: Do not place the corrupted-spirit alliance, every hostage capture or completed Nidhogg at the start of the fifteen-year plan.
events.frame: SO12 final confrontation reveals earlier planning

events.title: Freya rescues and names Ottar before his eventual blessing
events.when: Toddler rescue; Falna follows several years later, after he develops a sense of self.
events.changes: Freya takes in the abandoned child and gives him the name Ottar; he receives her blessing only years later.
events.knowledge: Ottar does not know his original name or lineage. Rescue is not immediate adventurer recruitment.
events.uncertainty: No exact rescue year, birth date or age at Falna inscription established.
events.frame: FC02 The Origin of the Strongest, childhood memories within the Udaeus-trip narrative

events.title: Ottar reaches Level Two after a delayed start to fighting
events.when: Two years after receiving Falna; only one year of active fighting within that period.
events.changes: Ottar becomes Level Two as a boy following the Familia’s internal combat.
events.uncertainty: Do not report one year from receiving Falna or date the unnamed intervening period precisely.

events.title: Mia cares for young Ottar and teaches him to think and ask
events.when: During Ottar’s childhood in Freya Familia; advice precedes puberty, before Mia’s later departure.
events.changes: Mia watches over the injured boy, feeds him and becomes Familia head. Her advice takes root; Ottar changes his eating habits.
events.knowledge: Ottar later hears from Freya that Mia intends to leave; her stated intention is not the actual departure.
events.uncertainty: Do not turn Mia’s care into formal adoption or assign a departure date to the conversation. Mia’s recruitment account is qualified as apparent in the narration.
events.frame: FC02 childhood scenes recalled during the contemporary journey

events.title: Kaguya joins after Alize and before Lyra
events.when: Early Astrea Familia formation, recalled during the gathering five years before the FC03 present.
events.changes: Alize recalls the order of the three early members; Kaguya attributes her change of heart to Astrea.
events.knowledge: This is the trio’s recollection, not a recruitment announcement made to Lyu.
events.uncertainty: Does not establish the full founding roster or exact duration between conversions. Alize and Kaguya disagree over whose persuasion deserves credit.
events.frame: FC03 A Simple Moment from Five Years Ago, historical gathering recalling earlier membership

events.title: Osiris survivors convert to Apate after their defeat
events.when: Osiris’s recorded defeat was twelve years before the AR01 battle; subsequent exile and conversions precede the Great Conflict.
events.changes: Osiris had concealed Level Six adventurers and its Level Seven captain Melty Zara. After defeat and expulsion, some second-tier survivors convert to Apate and train for revenge. Zeus and Hera’s later failure against the Black Dragon removes their intended opportunity.
events.knowledge: This history is reconstructed during AR01 from Guild records and Basram’s account. Hedin and Alfrik consulted the records before the present battle; no exact consultation date is supplied.
events.uncertainty: Basram says the first-tier members died or broke contact; this does not confirm Melty’s death. Do not assign a single date to the entire migration and training interval.
events.frame: AR01 retrospective exposition and battlefield account

events.title: Runoa gains her first Falna before her original Familia collapses
events.when: Childhood in an unnamed imperial territory, before her wandering career.
events.changes: War kills Runoa’s parents; she survives as a street child, joins a Familia and receives Falna. The group later destroys itself through infighting, leaving her to travel and hunt bounties, making provisional conversions for updates.
events.knowledge: She later hears that her patron treated coups and revolutions as a game; the later knowledge is not assigned to the child at recruitment.
events.uncertainty: God, territory, war and conversion dates remain unnamed. The stated three conversions precede the separately identified fifth Demeter membership.
events.frame: FC01 nested childhood recollection during Girl Meets Girls

events.title: Tiona discovers hero stories during her childhood fighting life
events.when: Before leaving Telskyura; exact age and date unstated in this recollection.
events.changes: Finding an old book opens an interest beyond fighting that she remembers vividly.
events.knowledge: She later tells the helmeted boy an abbreviated version while using the name Elna; she does not disclose her true identity or a complete Telskyura history.
events.uncertainty: The unnamed old book is not explicitly identified here as Argonaut or Arcadia. Do not turn the childhood dream’s entire dialogue into literal historical evidence.
events.frame: SS02 My Memory, recollection told during TL-0190; dream opening kept separate

events.title: Chloe learns who died protecting her and earns release from her first Familia
events.when: Before independent assassination work and before arriving in Orario.
events.changes: An assassin Chloe knew as an older-sister figure dies shielding her. Chloe later learns the woman was her mother, challenges the organization and completes deadly release demands including killing a Level Three knight with one knife. She levels up and is released.
events.knowledge: The maternal identity is learned after the death, not known throughout their earlier relationship.
events.uncertainty: No exact childhood age, release level or named knight/goddess is supplied. The later Level Four sheet cannot date every prior promotion.
events.frame: FC01 nested childhood and release recollection

events.title: Fels recalls the first contact with intelligent monsters
events.when: Fifteen, perhaps sixteen years before the FM09 discussion.
events.changes: Contact history predates Bell’s meeting with the hidden community.
events.knowledge: The interval belongs to Fels’s later account.
events.uncertainty: Speaker uncertainty is retained; this is not a precisely dated first individual birth.

events.title: Haruhime’s food donation brings the shrine children to her manor
events.when: Before meeting Mikoto; their first meeting is recalled as about ten years before FM07.
events.changes: Haruhime asks her father to send food to the impoverished shrine. The children visit the manor to discover their benefactor and decide to relieve her loneliness.
events.knowledge: Mikoto learns who sent the donation then; she tells Bell the story much later.
events.uncertainty: About ten years is approximate. No birthday or exact donation date is inferred.

events.title: Ottar is Level Five and second-in-command at seventeen
events.when: At age seventeen; exact birthday and absolute year not derived.
events.changes: Ottar is the undisputed second-in-command at Level Five; later narration describes his becoming captain without specifying the date. Mia has left by the point described in this historical sequence.
events.knowledge: He has already met the three Loki leaders as rivals. The account narrates recruitment of the elves, then Gullivers, then Allen and his sister.
events.uncertainty: The sweeping claim that all earlier members died sits beside Mia’s departure and survival. Do not apply it literally to Mia or invent a complete casualty roster.
events.frame: FC02 retrospective overview of changing leadership and the dark age

events.title: Takemikazuchi grants the children Falna so they can help Haruhime
events.when: After the donation; before repeated childhood outings and discovery by the manor guards.
events.changes: Takemikazuchi grants blessings earlier than his training requirement would normally allow. The children use their training and Statuses to bring Haruhime outside; after discovery he apologizes and they continue their visits.
events.knowledge: Haruhime forms friendships through the outings. The reader receives the reason for the early Falna grant in Mikoto’s later account.
events.uncertainty: Do not invent a complete named inscription roster or make the entire friendship happen on the first outing.
events.frame: FM07 Mikoto’s recollection, expanded the day after her first account

events.title: Freya recounts her earlier defeat by Hera to Ottar
events.when: Defeat before Freya settles in Orario; private telling to Ottar later, at an unspecified date.
events.changes: Freya’s earlier lost wager obliges her to assist Zeus and Hera and temporarily give up seeking Odr; she later abandons the intended revenge.
events.knowledge: Ottar hears the account privately while Freya drinks. His knowledge dates to this telling, not the earlier defeat.
events.uncertainty: No date for the conversation, unnamed opponent identification, or wider public knowledge established. Freya’s wine-in-the-face threat is not a completed event.
events.frame: FC02 Ottar recalls Freya’s account of a still earlier conflict

events.title: A dragon kills Bete’s tribe; he leaves the plains
events.when: Before Bete’s arrival in Orario and Víðarr membership.
events.changes: Bete alone survives; facial wound and subsequent lightning tattoo; begins seeking strength in Orario.
events.knowledge: Bete learns the creature came from the Valley of Dragons later, at an unspecified time.
events.uncertainty: Do not identify this flightless dragon as the Black Dragon or date its origin disclosure to the massacre.
events.frame: SO08 childhood memory, followed by contemporary waking

events.title: Bete joins Víðarr Familia and becomes its captain
events.when: After reaching Orario; before his return to the plains four years later.
events.changes: Bete becomes captain, receives Fenris alias, and falls in love with the human vice captain.
events.knowledge: These memories are not an on-page disclosure to Aiz.
events.uncertainty: The quoted strongest-combat-familia claim is narrative wording beside a midsize-familia description; do not use it to erase contemporary Loki/Freya supremacy. The woman is unnamed in these passages.

events.title: Lyu joins Astrea Familia and the eleven-girl oath
events.when: Approximately ten years before the FM14–15 present.
events.changes: Lyu receives Falna; nine listed girls plus Alize and Lyu make eleven.
events.knowledge: Lyu first receives the Familia’s stated ideal and commitment.
events.uncertainty: Combining year-scale intervals yields approximately ten years, never an exact anniversary. Staged MC-001 correction checked.
events.frame: FM15 recruitment memory; FM14 supplies independent destruction interval

events.title: Kali releases the twins with usable Statuses
events.when: Before the sisters’ five-year journey and eventual Loki conversion.
events.changes: Kali releases their contracts without stripping usable power; they travel and join successive Familias.
events.knowledge: Their worldly knowledge is initially limited despite combat experience.
events.uncertainty: Do not treat them as powerless throughout travel or invent each intermediate patron.

events.title: Aiz enters Loki Familia’s care
events.when: Nine years before the SO09 framing conversation; a winter day.
events.changes: Seven-year-old Aiz has Status in the remembered early training period.
events.knowledge: Loki’s group recalls her arrival; no full origin explanation to outsiders is established.
events.uncertainty: Do not derive a precise birthday or resolve her ancient-history problem by arithmetic.

events.title: Tsubaki observes young Aiz changing and begins making her hairpin
events.when: Aiz’s early childhood in Loki Familia; the workshop visit is a few days after Tsubaki’s second described Dungeon observation.
events.changes: Tsubaki sees less recklessness; Aiz asks for a hairpin and Tsubaki starts crafting it without charging.
events.knowledge: Tsubaki’s belief that Gareth urged the visit is explicitly her presumption. She did not know Aiz at the first sighting.
events.uncertainty: This is not Desperate’s acquisition, and completed delivery of the hairpin is not shown. Tsubaki’s assessment of gradual change is not an instant end to Aiz’s obsession.
events.frame: SS02 Recollection of a Blacksmith, retrospective sequence

events.title: Young Aiz resists Riveria’s swimming instruction
events.when: About nine years before the post-Meren telling, when Aiz is seven.
events.changes: Aiz prefers sword practice to swimming; Riveria insists on addressing weaknesses.
events.knowledge: This recalled exchange concerns childhood instruction, not current mastery.
events.uncertainty: The later adamantite-and-water account is Loki’s narration, recorded separately from this exchange.
events.frame: SS02 Traumatic Memories of Days Gone By, childhood opening recalled in a later conversation

events.title: Freya finds Allen and Anya after their homeland’s destruction
events.when: Two years after their home was destroyed; Allen is six at the encounter.
events.changes: The siblings’ wandering ends when Allen takes Freya’s hand.
events.knowledge: Allen’s childhood understanding of the ruins is limited; some identification is learned later.
events.uncertainty: This passage does not name the destroyer. Age six is not a birthday.
events.frame: FC02 Their Various Pasts, childhood recollection

events.title: Hedin and Hegni rule rival elven states before receiving Falna
events.when: Before their recruitment by Freya; absolute year unknown.
events.changes: Two kings develop exceptional combat abilities without Falna; neither is a high elf.
events.knowledge: The ancestral Hildr dispute belongs to the narrator’s account; no present-day public disclosure is established.
events.uncertainty: Do not assign a numerical adventurer level to their pre-Falna power.

events.title: Freya ends the two kings’ duel and recruits them
events.when: After three days of unresolved combat at the destruction of their states.
events.changes: The two rulers abandon their old world for Freya.
events.knowledge: Freya admits provoking their countries’ destruction; both understand her intervention then.
events.uncertainty: Their allegiance is explicit; precise Falna-inscription time is not supplied. Children are expressly excluded from the final mass mobilization; the death of the combatants does not establish that every inhabitant or child died.

events.title: Freya recruits the Gulliver craftsmen
events.when: Four days after her necklace commission, in their undated pre-Orario history.
events.changes: The brothers kill their former employer after learning of Freya’s bargain, then swear allegiance and become her followers. The brothers kill their exploiter after learning of Freya’s bargain. Their necklace is named Bringar; after Freya returns, they swear allegiance.
events.knowledge: Their wordless understanding predates adventuring. The younger brothers learn the extent of Alfrik’s rage in this incident.
events.uncertainty: Do not turn figurative mutual understanding into unrestricted literal telepathy.

events.title: Loki’s leaders conceal Aiz’s already-present magic
events.when: Early Level One period, after her first dangerous Dungeon outings and before the wyvern encounter.
events.changes: The leaders agree to prioritize education and emotional control rather than reveal the magic already present in Aiz’s Status.
events.knowledge: Loki, Riveria, Gareth and Finn discuss the magic and dangerous skill. Aiz has not been told about the magic.
events.uncertainty: This scene bounds knowledge, not the exact acquisition moment or a universal public secret roster.
events.frame: SO09 childhood recollection intercut with the later Rakian-war frame

events.title: The name Syr is exchanged with Freya
events.when: Before the established tavern life; exact acquisition date unresolved.
events.changes: Identity/name bargain forms part of the later Syr secret.
events.knowledge: Reader sees the bargain; Bell and Anya do not learn it in this historical scene.
events.uncertainty: The childhood girl’s source name is Syr. Editorial identification uses later eligible clarification without pretending it was disclosed publicly then.
events.frame: FC02 retrospective origin vignette, followed by a separate Bell-era cooking scene

events.title: Aiz uses the wind against the black wyvern and accepts Riveria’s care
events.when: Near the end of her first adventuring year in SO09’s childhood recollection; before the Great Conflict.
events.changes: Riveria supplies the chant; Aiz invokes Airiel, destroys the wyvern’s head and survives the explosion wounded and exhausted. She recognizes her parents’ continuing influence and accepts Riveria’s embrace and declaration of love.
events.knowledge: Aiz now consciously uses the wind she had not been told about earlier. This is not the first appearance of the magic on her Status.
events.uncertainty: The black wyvern is not the One-Eyed Black Dragon. The exact eight-years-before-present placement is not independently stated in these selected lines. This moment of comfort does not erase later anger or isolation.
events.frame: SO09 childhood climax, separate from Bell/Hestia scenes that follow

events.title: Raul and Anakitty join Loki Familia eight years before SO07
events.when: Eight years before the SO07 Knossos encounter, before the Great Conflict.
events.changes: The narrator dates both adventurers’ joining to eight years earlier. By the encounter they have personal familiarity with the conflict against the Evils.
events.knowledge: They recognize Valletta; newer companions need Finn’s explanation.
events.uncertainty: A shared year label does not prove the same day, joint conversion ceremony, exact birthday or identical early levels.
events.frame: SO07 encounter with retrospective membership explanation

events.title: Lilly’s orphaning precedes Zanis’s already established leadership
events.when: Orphaning after her earliest age-three memory; Zanis scene after her sixth birthday.
events.changes: Lilly loses her parents; Zanis is already Familia head in the later childhood scene.
events.knowledge: The allegation that Zanis killed the former head is rumor, not a witnessed murder.
events.uncertainty: A broad childhood interval, not simultaneous orphaning and appointment. Neither date is derived from present age.

events.title: Aiz’s first promotion establishes the one-year Level Two record
events.when: One year after becoming an adventurer; precise update ceremony date unshown here.
events.changes: Aiz reaches Level Two in one year, a record later discussed in the twins’ recruitment recollection.
events.knowledge: Tione learns the record when she encounters Aiz’s history after joining; that later learning is separate from the promotion.
events.uncertainty: The passage does not give a calendar date or separately demonstrate the exact update interval after the black-wyvern fight. A first mention of the record is not the event date.
events.frame: SO06 twins’ recruitment-era recollection of Aiz’s still earlier promotion

events.title: Runoa reaches Orario, suffers defeat and grows to Level Four
events.when: Before the historical tavern confrontation; arrival is described both as three years and almost four years before that frame.
events.changes: Runoa’s attempt against a Freya follower ends in flight from four prums. She chooses later jobs more carefully, continues growing and is explicitly Four by the tavern-era update.
events.knowledge: The defeat teaches her that success outside Orario does not make her invincible inside it.
events.uncertainty: Preserve the conflicting arrival wording. The third level-up is consistent with Four but not an exact update date. No named target or death of a Gulliver brother is supplied.
events.frame: FC01 arrival history within the older tavern narrative

events.title: Chloe reaches Orario, survives Ankusha and eventually reaches Four
events.when: Arrival described as almost four years before the historical Girl Meets Girls frame; ensuing jobs precede the tavern encounter.
events.changes: Chloe fails a contract on a Ganesha follower and escapes Ankusha. She becomes more selective, works under stated target restrictions and later reaches Level Four. Exhaustion and a wish for belonging grow.
events.knowledge: Chloe’s declared restrictions describe this period of work; they are not proof about every act since infancy.
events.uncertainty: The named pursuer is Ankusha; the intended target is not explicitly named. Almost four years remains approximate and is relative to the older story frame.

events.title: Runoa contracts with Demeter while remaining apart from everyday Familia life
events.when: After arriving in Orario, before the tavern confrontation and shown Level Four update.
events.changes: Runoa enters her fifth divine affiliation for Status updates while keeping her occupational and social distance. She stops accepting contracts against Guild-aligned factions after meeting Demeter.
events.knowledge: The change in her contract choices is explicitly unknown to others. Divine affiliation is not the same as joining agricultural daily life.
events.uncertainty: Exact conversion date remains unknown. The source calls her both contracted and not a member in its social sense; do not erase either distinction.

events.title: Chloe uses a smuggling discovery to obtain Njörðr’s patronage
events.when: After beginning work in Orario and before the shown tavern-era Status update.
events.changes: Chloe witnesses Njörðr receiving suspicious freight and uses it as leverage for a convenient divine contract and updates.
events.knowledge: She knows of smuggling but expressly does not know the cargo’s details or full explanation.
events.uncertainty: Do not assign the cargo a named later SO revelation or claim Chloe knows the full conspiracy. Exact sighting and conversion dates remain unknown.
events.frame: FC01 retrospective explanation inside Njörðr visit

events.title: Bete returns north and kills the Master of the Plains
events.when: Departure four years after arriving in Orario, age sixteen and Level Three; three-month outward journey.
events.changes: Bete wins after a night-long battle, suffering wounds and broken bones and losing weapons.
events.uncertainty: No ninety-day conversion; no exact date of the preceding Level Three update.

events.title: Bete discovers his lover’s death and parts from Víðarr Familia
events.when: After returning from the northern dragon hunt; before Loki recruitment.
events.changes: His lover has died on a Dungeon raid; injured survivors leave Orario. Bete stays with a blessing made available for conversion.
events.knowledge: Bete learns of her death on his return; he did not witness the fatal raid.
events.uncertainty: Not every member died; departure is not evidence all Falna vanished.
events.frame: SO08 memory triggered by apparent loss of Lena

events.title: Bete’s remembered arrival in Loki Familia
events.when: Six years before the SS02 telling.
events.changes: Bete has joined; Aiz encounters his harsh attitude.
events.knowledge: Aiz does not know the circumstances that led to his admission. Loki later tells Tiona, Tione and Lefiya that the troll fight made Bete fall for Aiz; that interpretation is attributed to Loki, not a confession by Bete.
events.uncertainty: Precise anniversary not established.
events.frame: SS02 A Reason to Fall in Love

events.title: Lyu and Kaguya are already Three before the Great Conflict
events.when: By the industrial-quarter operation at the opening of AR01, before the catastrophe.
events.changes: Lyu and Kaguya are both Level Three. Their argument exposes tension over Lyu’s emotionally driven tactics while their companions intervene verbally.
events.knowledge: Their colleagues witness the quarrel; this is not disclosure of a new promotion.
events.uncertainty: The update itself is not shown.
events.frame: AR01 historical opening; earlier promotion date unknown

events.title: Bete adjusts to Loki Familia and reaches Level Four
events.when: After induction into Loki Familia; precise interval unknown.
events.changes: Initially isolated and combative; later expeditions improve relationships and he reaches Level Four.
events.knowledge: He develops respect for colleagues through experience, not instant reconciliation on joining.
events.uncertainty: No exact Level Four date; later harshness persists.

events.title: Erebus, Zald and Alfia choose their trial before the Great Conflict
events.when: Before the Great Conflict, not after its narrated conclusion.
events.changes: They knowingly become deadly obstacles for the next generation.
events.knowledge: Private conversation reveals the sister’s child, Zeus’s guardianship and a Zeus Familia father; no disclosure to Bell.
events.uncertainty: Father remains unnamed. Do not convert private ancestry evidence into Lyu or Bell knowing it.
events.frame: AR03 retrospective Extra plus later explanatory divine conversation

events.title: Welf receives Phobos’s Falna and proves he can forge magic swords
events.when: Welf’s tenth birthday; FM08 places discovery of his talent seven years before its present confrontation.
events.changes: Welf receives Level One Falna with Blood of Crozzo. His tested magic shortsword burns the field and breaks. His family demands more; their rejection of his smithing ideal drives his decision to leave.
events.knowledge: Phobos and family see his Status and the successful weapon test. The skill name alone is not unique to Welf; narration says others in the family have it.
events.uncertainty: No calendar birthday is derived. FM15 prints Vil and FM08 Wil for his father; quotations retain each source spelling. This rejection is not his later reconsideration of magic swords.
events.frame: FM15 Welf childhood recollection; FM08 corroborating retrospective

events.title: Welf escapes Barva with his second magic sword and vows to stop forging them
events.when: Escape planned late on the birthday night for the following day; carried out on the following rainy night.
events.changes: Phobos helps Welf through the checkpoints. Marius has independently increased security. Welf uses the second sword to break out, critically injuring three Level Two knights; the sword crumbles. He swears never to forge another magic sword.
events.knowledge: Welf experiences the weapon’s destructive power and resents it. The reader sees Marius’s security order; Welf does not know why inspections changed.
events.uncertainty: The knights are critically injured, not explicitly confirmed dead. The oath is a historical conviction, not an unbroken rule after later developments.
events.frame: FM15 escape with separate palace viewpoint

events.title: Phobos updates and releases Welf while preserving his usable abilities
events.when: After the escape, at the arranged meeting outside Barva; before leaving Rakia.
events.changes: Phobos performs her first and last Status update on Welf and releases his pact without sealing the improved abilities. He is able to convert later. She directs him toward a passing caravan and returns to face the consequences.
events.knowledge: Welf hears her intention to take responsibility and her willingness to risk being sent to heaven. He does not witness the later proceedings in Barva.
events.uncertainty: Release is not an immediate Hephaistos conversion or loss of usable Falna. The caravan is an instruction here, not a separately shown boarding scene.

events.title: Welf sees a divine return from Barva after parting from Phobos
events.when: Several days after the parting, while Welf is outside Rakia’s borders.
events.changes: Welf sees a pillar of light from Barva and gives a tearful farewell. The immediate narrative context identifies this as the consequence Phobos had anticipated.
events.knowledge: Welf sees the distant pillar, not the execution or deliberations.
events.uncertainty: The return is strongly contextualized as Phobos’s, but these lines do not show who personally sends her back. Do not certify Ares as executioner from this scene alone.
events.frame: FM15 distant witnessed outcome after Phobos’s warning

events.title: Hephaistos invites Welf to join her in Solingen
events.when: After Welf’s escape and arrival in Solingen; exact travel interval and conversion day unshown.
events.changes: Welf works for room and board. Hephaistos watches him forge, then invites him into her Familia; he withholds his surname at this meeting.
events.knowledge: Hephaistos meets him as Welf. The smith doubts his given identity; that doubt is not proof his name is false.
events.uncertainty: Invitation is shown, not the precise Falna-inscription ceremony or instant arrival in Orario. No later skill, equipment or romantic promise is backdated.

events.title: Basram creates twelve spirit warriors through coerced experiments
events.when: After the converts lose their revenge objective, before the opening Great Conflict battle; Level Five is described as recently reached.
events.changes: Basram uses drugs, curses and captured lesser spirits to turn unwilling subjects into controlled fighters, then trains them secretly in the Dungeon. Forty-two spirits and thirty-four warriors yield twelve surviving spirit warriors after failed infusions and monster losses.
events.knowledge: The later battlefield explanation supplies the origin to the reader and nearby listeners; creation itself is earlier. Basram reports regeneration and lack of Great Spirits.
events.uncertainty: Do not treat the initial subject totals as a complete named casualty roster, the recent promotions as exact dates, or these experiments as a universal rule for spirit contracts.
events.frame: AR01 retrospective experiment history within Basram’s explanation

events.title: Lydis asks Asfi to succeed her before the catastrophe
events.when: An undated tavern lunch before Lydis’s death; recalled during the third conflict day.
events.changes: Lydis states her wish that Asfi become captain after her death; Asfi initially treats it as a tasteless joke. The tavern is described as having been in business for two years at this earlier lunch.
events.knowledge: Asfi hears the request. Lydis says she will tell Hermes; this particular passage does not show that delivery.
events.uncertainty: A succession request is not the effective appointment. Two years of tavern business is anchored to the lunch, not an exact founding date calculated from Bell’s present.
events.frame: AR02 flashback to an earlier tavern conversation

events.title: Astrea Familia patrols in the countdown to the Great Conflict
events.when: AR01 local countdown reaches ten days before the Great Conflict immediately before the patrol chapter.
events.changes: Peacekeeping is already established in the Age of Darkness.
events.uncertainty: Do not silently equate the chapter transition with the exact same day. This AR anchor is not the project’s Bell-era Day 0.

events.title: Ardee dies in the warehouse bombing
events.when: AR01 coordinated-base assault, before the declaration initiating the Seven Days of Death.
events.changes: Ardee killed; Lyu’s grief and rage become immediate continuity constraints.
events.knowledge: Lyu witnesses the attack and initially cannot accept the death; no later recovery.

events.title: Shakti carries Lyu out of the collapsing warehouse
events.when: Immediately after Ardee’s death, as the coordinated raid becomes a bombing trap.
events.changes: Neze pulls Celty toward escape and the upstairs Astrea party follows. Kaguya has a bleeding arm. Shakti restrains and carries Lyu out while the remaining attack-force survivors flee. Lyu picks up Ardee’s sword during the attempted return.
events.knowledge: Lyra warns the others that fallen enemies carry bombs. Lyu cannot accept Ardee’s loss; Shakti chooses escape despite her own grief.
events.uncertainty: Some Ganesha attackers die, but this passage gives no complete roster or total. Picking up the sword is not permanent ownership or the later permission to carry it.

events.title: Parallel raids leave five Freya followers dead while Loki’s party survives
events.when: The opening coordinated bombings, before the conquerors defeat the first-tier adventurers.
events.changes: Ottar opens an escape route; Allen reports five lost, with many others receiving healing. Loki’s infiltration party has no deaths but many injuries, treated in Riveria’s group healing circle.
events.knowledge: Finn recognizes the raid explosions as a signal for an attack on the city. Asfi and Falgar witness the citywide destruction from a gambling-house vantage point.
events.uncertainty: The five losses concern this Freya raid, not the entire conflict. Loki’s no-deaths statement is likewise local to this infiltration party and moment; it cannot erase later casualties.

events.title: Hegni faces the Dis sisters and Bringar confront Basram
events.when: Opening-night northern fighting, before news of Ottar’s defeat destabilizes the defenders.
events.changes: Hedin and Hegni are Level Five, as are Dina and Vena, Alecto’s captain and vice-captain. The rivalry predates this encounter: an initial draw led to repeated clashes. Basram deploys the new force after Freya Familia previously killed Apate’s captain, vice-captain and notable lieutenants.
events.knowledge: Hegni recognizes the sisters; Alfrik recognizes Basram but initially only suspects the nature of his fighters. Neither encounter is a first meeting of all these rivals.
events.uncertainty: Earlier clashes and Apate officer deaths have no exact dates here. About-seventy ages do not establish birthdays; Hegni’s conjecture about the sisters’ past is not a confirmed persecution history.
events.frame: AR01 encounter with undated rivalry exposition

events.title: Zald defeats Ottar on the opening night
events.when: After the bombing raids, before Allen’s rescue and the later rematch.
events.changes: Ottar recognizes Zald, attacks and is disarmed and gravely wounded. Narration describes broken bones throughout his body. He remains alive despite Olivas’s celebratory claim of death.
events.knowledge: Ottar knows Zald from prior encounters and the Behemoth battle, but had heard uncertain reports of retirement or death. Recognition of the returned opponent does not reveal the later private plan. Olivas spreads news of the defeat among the enemy.
events.uncertainty: Defeat is not death, resurrection or permanent loss of ability. The reported historical death of Zald was uncertain hearsay, not a prior confirmed event.

events.title: Riveria and Gareth recognize Alfia and fall to her attack
events.when: Opening-night parallel battle; their final collapse follows the news of Ottar’s defeat.
events.changes: Riveria attacks after finding Alfia among slain adventurers. Gareth joins and is hurled into a building. Both recognize her; later Riveria’s barrier is exhausted and both collapse. Asfi arrives at the defeat scene.
events.knowledge: Riveria and Gareth learn that Alfia is alive and fighting for the enemy. Her stated disappointment and threat to end the Age of Gods are not a disclosure of the full hidden objective.
events.uncertainty: Alfia’s wards on her dress protect it from her own magic, not necessarily from external attacks. Her apparent defense does not grant these witnesses Lyra’s later explanation of its mechanism.

events.title: Allen and Asfi rescue the fallen first-tier adventurers
events.when: Immediately after the opening defeats; the two rescues occur at the same moment in different streets.
events.changes: Allen abandons his silver spear for speed and carries Ottar away before Zald’s finishing blow; Allen’s left arm is injured. Asfi uses bombs and unfinished winged sandals to extract Riveria and Gareth. The sandals provide midair acceleration, not flight. Neither conqueror pursues.
events.knowledge: Allen reverses his earlier departure order after witnessing the defeat. Rescue does not supply the victims with knowledge of every concurrent battle.
events.uncertainty: No spear-retrieval time, sandal-completion date or instant healing is established. The conquerors’ decision not to pursue is not proof the preceding injuries or deaths were staged.

events.title: Finn learns of the defeats and concentrates the defense around Babel
events.when: After the opening rescues, before Erebus’s public declaration and the sustained siege.
events.changes: Messengers report that Riveria and Gareth are rescued but badly wounded and unconscious. Finn orders withdrawal from southern districts and concentration in the city center, sending orders north to Freya Familia.
events.knowledge: Finn identifies Alfia from the messenger’s description. He still questions who is directing the attacks. Separately, Hermes and Astrea infer a hidden divine planner; these deductions are not the later confession.
events.uncertainty: The initial report that the southwest was wiped out immediately admits survivors. Treat it as a crushed front, not universal death. Orders do not prove every unit has already withdrawn. Raul’s less-than-one-year residence is not an exact arrival date.
events.frame: AR01 command reports and separate divine suspicions

events.title: Hedin exposes the northern enemy force and enables a retreat
events.when: After Ottar’s defeat distracts Hegni, during the opening-night northern collapse.
events.changes: Hegni is badly wounded and the Level Four Gulliver brothers are overwhelmed by twelve Level Five spirit warriors. Hedin leaves his command post, drives back the enemy with existing spells and orders Van and Noga to evacuate his comrades. Their escape succeeds.
events.knowledge: Hedin identifies the former Osiris fighters through previously consulted Guild records. Alfrik hears Basram explain spirit infusion. Hedin sees the force’s numerical advantage; this is not a public citywide briefing.
events.uncertainty: The diagnosis of mortal wounds does not certify Hegni’s death. Rescue does not establish complete healing. Hedin’s departure temporarily disrupts command and exposes shelters to danger.
events.frame: AR01 northern defeat, disclosure and rescue

events.title: The Dis sisters destroy three shelters while Hedin saves the cathedral
events.when: Immediately after the northern retreat, before Hedin can regain his command post.
events.changes: Vena unleashes a prepared spell against four churches with Dina channeling energy. Hedin cancels the attack on the cathedral where Olba and others are stationed, but the other three churches burn and civilians die.
events.knowledge: Hedin witnesses the destruction and hears the victims. Narration explains that Vena had prepared and held the chant since Hegni’s encounter; this was not an ultra-short cast.
events.uncertainty: No exact death count or complete survivor list is supplied. Saving one cathedral is not saving every shelter; the sisters’ taunt is not an objective statement that Hedin intended these deaths.

events.title: The Seven Days of Death begin
events.when: AR local conflict day 1; seven years before the framing memorial.
events.changes: Orario enters the sustained catastrophe.
events.knowledge: Erebus’s declared objective is public rhetoric; private aim must not be assumed known.
events.frame: Historical conflict; distinguished from AR01 Bell/Hermes prologue

events.title: Lydis dies protecting retreating adventurers and Asfi becomes captain
events.when: Lydis dies on the opening conflict night; Hermes appoints Asfi afterward, by the AR02 siege scenes.
events.changes: Lydis sacrifices herself so upper-class adventurers can escape. Hermes tells Asfi that she is now captain. Asfi struggles with the responsibility while grieving.
events.knowledge: Hermes directly informs Asfi of the death and succession. Her earlier occasional performance of captain’s duties was not this permanent succession.
events.uncertainty: Exact appointment hour and complete roster of those saved are not supplied. Asfi’s stated age fifteen does not establish a birth date.
events.frame: AR02 retrospective death and appointment within the siege narrative

events.title: Nine divine returns strip endangered followers of their blessings
events.when: Opening conflict night; nine pillars appear across Orario.
events.changes: Nine gods return to heaven. The Evils exploit the resulting loss of blessings to attack weakened adventurers. Reports identify Belenus’s return and Zelus Familia’s destruction.
events.knowledge: The city witnesses the pillars; Royman initially calls the losses nine of their own familias. Hermes infers that earlier raids exposed divine hiding places. The underground purpose is not yet known.
events.uncertainty: Only six returns are later identified as allied. Do not invent names for all nine or equate every report with a complete casualty roster.
events.frame: AR01 mass returns, with AR02’s early mistaken summary preserved

events.title: An enemy god’s underground Arcanum is concealed by the nine returns
events.when: Opening conflict night, during the mass returns; timing reconstructed by the gods near the final battle.
events.changes: The Evils use the overwhelming surface Arcanum to mask a god unleashing power underground and calling forth the black monster. Three of the returning gods are enemy sacrifices.
events.knowledge: This event’s purpose is not disclosed to the defenders on the night it happens. Hermes, Astrea, Loki and Freya discuss it later.
events.uncertainty: The original underground god remains unnamed; do not substitute Erebus merely because he later goes underground. No precise minute, full causal rule or complete divine casualty list supplied.
events.frame: AR02 later reconstruction of an earlier concealed operation

events.title: The second-day siege blocks evacuation while injured leaders return to duty
events.when: Second of the Seven Days of Death.
events.changes: Enemy forces hold the walls and bomb people gathering at the gates. Defenders prevent civilians walking into the encirclement. Gareth remains bandaged after ordinary treatment; Riveria is still injured but deployed to supervise Aiz. Supplies and routes to Meren are cut off.
events.knowledge: Finn briefs Gareth on Erebus and Zald after Gareth missed events following his defeat. Early reasoning about enemy restraint remains analysis, not knowledge of every hidden motive.
events.uncertainty: Returning to duty does not imply complete healing. Reports of Meren’s distress and blocked evacuation are not proof of universal death there. The later Artemis arrival qualifies current pessimism about reinforcement.
events.frame: AR02 second-day gate crisis and war-room briefing

events.title: Aiz fights human enemies at Level Three under a no-killing restriction
events.when: AR02 early conflict, after the previous night’s defeat of the leading defenders.
events.changes: Aiz wears the Alice Dress of War commissioned by Finn and incapacitates enemies without killing them. Riveria remains injured.
events.knowledge: Riveria imposed the restriction; Finn insisted Aiz contribute despite her objections.
events.uncertainty: No claim Aiz had never fought people before or that this temporary restriction is a universal lifetime rule.

events.title: Shakti’s orders deepen the rupture with Lyu, while her private grief remains unseen
events.when: Second-day wandering, before the third-day search for Lyu.
events.changes: Shakti assigns care and burial work to civilians and Guild staff so her followers can defend them. She orders lethal force if capture becomes impossible. Lyu confronts her condemnation of Ardee’s mercy and runs away.
events.knowledge: After Lyu leaves, Shakti privately questions her own choice and expresses grief to Ganesha. Lyu does not hear that qualification.
events.uncertainty: The outward harshness is not proof that Shakti ceased loving her sister or felt no doubt. No immediate reconciliation is shown.
events.frame: AR02 public orders, confrontation and subsequent private exchange

events.title: Allen defeats a shaken Ottar after the first Zald encounter
events.when: AR02, after Ottar awakens from his defeat by Zald; before the later prolonged internal training.
events.changes: Level Five Allen disarms and defeats the physically and mentally devastated Level Six Ottar.
events.knowledge: Allen explicitly says their normal result would be the reverse.
events.uncertainty: Do not turn this result into Allen being generally stronger, or into evidence of a completed rank-up.

events.title: Falgar supports the new captain as Asfi resumes decisive command
events.when: Third conflict day, concurrent with Kaguya and Lyra’s northern search.
events.changes: Gareth assigns enemy-leader reconnaissance to Hermes Familia. Falgar refuses Asfi’s attempt to surrender the captaincy and encourages her. She orders reconnaissance and supply collection, then scouts alone while Falgar leads the others.
events.knowledge: Falgar fulfills his earlier promise to Lydis to support Asfi. Asfi’s impression of Lydis during the exchange is not independent evidence of a returned spirit.
events.uncertainty: New resolve is not immunity to later anxiety, nor a level-up or new item acquisition. Falgar does not become captain here.

events.title: Fels secretly supports the defenders and withdraws from attempting resurrection
events.when: During the third-day struggle sequence; covert work has continued since the conflict began.
events.changes: Fels uses existing items to fight, heal, suppress riots and relay scouting information through the Guild. On orders to investigate the sewers, Fels hesitates over a dead child, then withdraws after Ouranos forbids resurrection.
events.knowledge: Ouranos knows Fels’s covert role. The defenders receive intelligence without the passage establishing that they know its hidden source.
events.uncertainty: No resurrection is performed, no success probability is demonstrated, and no permanent ban is inferred for all later circumstances. The Reverse Veil is not perfect undetectability; Ouranos explicitly warns of its limits.
events.frame: AR02 covert present operation and summary of earlier assistance

events.title: Raul and Anakitty defend the Bridge of Heroes and earn promotion
events.when: Third-day struggle sequence; the precise later Status-update ceremony is not shown here.
events.changes: Exhausted and distressed, the two messengers encounter Goibniu repairing the bridge and its statues. They regain resolve and face six enemy attackers. Narration states that they earn promotion to Level Two.
events.knowledge: Goibniu explains why preserving the bridge matters. Their admiration does not reveal the full histories of its thirty-one heroes.
events.uncertainty: Distinguish earning promotion from a shown Falna update. Do not grant Level Two at the start of this confrontation or assume fear disappears permanently.
events.frame: AR02 third-day bridge scene with promotion outcome summarized

events.title: Astrea treats the overflowing civilian camp; Asfi joins the search for Lyu
events.when: Third-day camp sequence, extending toward evening; before the explicitly fourth-day enemy gathering.
events.changes: With hospitals full and potions prioritized for adventurers, Astrea uses ordinary supplies and performs necessary amputations. Asfi asks for Lyu’s help and learns she is missing; Astrea asks her to search.
events.knowledge: The volunteer hears Astrea’s warning about divine escalation, but not her quieter unfinished reference to the promised time and Dungeon. Bogan overhears the news of Ardee’s death.
events.uncertainty: This records the novel’s fictional treatment and shortages, not a real-world medical recommendation. No blanket patient recovery, divine healing or disclosure of the covenant to the volunteers is established.
events.frame: AR02 camp care and separate overheard disclosure

events.title: Kaguya and Lyra escape Alfia wounded
events.when: AR02 encounter before the public recovery of hope and the fifth-day dawn.
events.changes: Alfia has a minor arm wound and lets the girls go; Lyra must support the badly injured Kaguya.
events.knowledge: The girls recognize the need for the entire team; Lyra’s wish that Lyu stay away does not reach her.
events.uncertainty: No instant full recovery or date of healing inferred.

events.title: Finn and Loki find only six allied gods in the nine-return report
events.when: Before the Olivas assault and its defeat; AR02 war-room investigation.
events.changes: The report Hermes brings names six allied divine losses, including Belenus and Zelus, leaving three of the nine returns unaccounted for on their side. Finn suspects enemy gods and a concealed purpose belowground.
events.knowledge: Finn and Loki reach this suspicion privately. Raul’s arrival reports the imminent attack; it does not establish that every defender already knows their deduction.
events.uncertainty: Three enemy returns are initially an inference, not yet a publicly demonstrated complete account. The remaining names are not supplied.
events.frame: AR02 investigation immediately before Olivas’s attack

events.title: Astrea Familia’s answer renews hope after Olivas’s defeat
events.when: Before the dawn of conflict day five; AR02.
events.changes: Asfi is injured; Astrea Familia voices its continuing pursuit of justice; Olivas survives and is recovering.
events.knowledge: The declaration reaches named listeners across the city. It is not a disclosure of Erebus’s private plan.
events.uncertainty: The speech does not permanently cure Lyu’s doubts, as the text itself anticipates later wavering.

events.title: Lyu chooses conditional forgiveness for the thief who protected her
events.when: After the Olivas confrontation, during the temporary respite.
events.changes: The badly injured man survives; Lyu accepts his pledge to return stolen armor and make amends.
events.knowledge: Lyu credits Ardee with teaching her that forgiveness can be necessary.
events.uncertainty: The man’s rapid improvement does not define a general recovery rate for adventurers.

events.title: Orario endures the middle days of the catastrophe
events.when: AR local days 2–6; AR02.
events.changes: City fear persists; Olivas’s defeat precedes the dawn of day five.
events.uncertainty: This grouped interval is not a scene-by-scene assignment of every AR02 action.

events.title: Dungeon reconnaissance reports the ascending monster before the final briefing
events.when: Scouts dispatched two days before the midnight briefing, after Olivas’s defeat; monster sighted at noon before that briefing.
events.changes: Finn orders reconnaissance following the Olivas confrontation. Scouts report a huge monster ascending through Floor 24 and destroying its surroundings; the Guild assesses at least deep-floor Monster Rex strength.
events.knowledge: The scouting report reaches Finn before he addresses the assembled defenders. The assessment is not an exact numerical level measurement.
events.uncertainty: Do not turn dispatch into a full two-day observed ascent or infer the creature’s speed over unobserved floors. Scouts are unnamed in this passage.

events.title: Freya’s elites train until Ottar regains his resolve
events.when: Near the transition into the sixth conflict night; before Finn gathers the final force.
events.changes: The elites are bloodied and exhausted; Ottar wins the last duel with Allen and recovers clarity and determination.
events.knowledge: Allen’s final warning and Ottar’s answer are explicit; there is no Level Seven update yet.
events.uncertainty: Healers enable continued fighting; no blanket statement that every wound is erased.

events.title: Finn reveals the monster threat and divides the final defense
events.when: Midnight preceding the final showdown, after the closing preparations.
events.changes: Finn tells the assembled force that a god is being used to draw a Dungeon monster upward to destroy Babel. He announces a surface defense and an underground interception team.
events.knowledge: Asfi and the others visibly learn the threat here. Lyra’s apparent panic is a deliberate performance to prompt Finn’s answer; her aside tells Lyu it is an act.
events.uncertainty: The operational revelation is not the later private truth about Erebus’s desire to produce heroes. Planned division of forces is not an assertion that every individual already occupies the final position.

events.title: The gods explain why the nine returns hid the summoning
events.when: During the midnight gathering and its parallel divine conversations.
events.changes: Loki and Freya discuss the black-monster mechanism; nearby Hermes and Astrea explain the interference created by the surface returns and the sacrifice of enemy gods.
events.knowledge: The two conversations confirm the hidden operation to these named participants. The assembled adventurers hearing Finn’s speech are not automatically witnesses to every divine aside.
events.uncertainty: Loki’s comparison to the earlier Black Wyvern is an analogy grounded in experience, not a complete account of every possible Dungeon response or the summoning god’s identity.
events.frame: AR02 divine asides reconstructing the earlier hidden operation

events.title: Orario’s civilians are concentrated in five strongholds
events.when: AR03 last-intermission preparations before the final-day battle.
events.changes: Loki reports evacuation to Guild HQ, arena, casino, Ganesha’s home and Twilight Manor; adventurers take defensive positions.
events.knowledge: Finn receives the evacuation report; the stated completeness is the report’s claim.
events.uncertainty: Do not use the report to certify every individual’s whereabouts beyond its stated scope.

events.title: Finn’s final briefing reveals the conquerors’ limited fighting time
events.when: Eve of the decisive battle, a few hours before final-day combat; narrated later as a flashback.
events.changes: Finn briefs Astrea Familia on Alfia’s congenital illness and Zald’s Behemoth poisoning; the advised strategy is to survive until their conditions take their toll.
events.knowledge: The girls learn the Behemoth-killing mechanism here. Finn’s access to confidential records is older, after Zeus and Hera’s fall. Hermes’s investigators linked the stolen supplies to the two conquerors on the first conflict night and informed Finn then.
events.uncertainty: The briefing’s continued-illness conclusion is reasoned intelligence, confirmed in battle later. No full ancestry disclosure, magic acquisition or public release of Guild records is implied.
events.frame: AR03 battle flashback to the preceding war-room briefing

events.title: Lyu carries Ardee’s sword into the final battle with Shakti’s permission
events.when: Before dawn on the seventh conflict day; permission was obtained by then.
events.changes: Lyu carries newly completed Alvs Lumina and Ardee’s Sacred Oath. Lyra carries Asfi’s special shield at Finn’s instruction. Asfi reports seventy-seven hours without a break.
events.knowledge: Asfi recognizes the second sword and hears Lyu confirm it belonged to Ardee. Shakti’s permission predates this exchange, with no exact grant time.
events.uncertainty: Carrying permission is not a permanent ownership transfer. No indefinite later storage location, exact sword completion day or fully rested Asfi is established.

events.title: Lyu conceals her earlier masked fight from the young Aiz
events.when: During the final-day Dungeon descent; Lyu recalls the confrontation five days earlier.
events.changes: Aiz notices familiar eyes and voice but accepts Lyu’s false explanation about a snack dispute.
events.knowledge: Lyu fears Alize and Riveria learning the confrontation. Aiz does not recognize her as the masked attacker here. The reader receives the actual recollection.
events.uncertainty: This historical confrontation is not the later Daedalus Street fight or its SS02 disclosure. The snack dispute is a cover story, not an independently attested meeting.
events.frame: AR03 contemporary descent with earlier confrontation recalled

events.title: Alfia intercepts the underground party and Alize rejects standing aside
events.when: Final-day Floor 18 interception, before Delphyne breaks through.
events.changes: Alfia offers to leave the party unharmed if they remain inactive. Alize refuses and the party attacks.
events.knowledge: Except Lyu, Kaguya and Lyra, the Astrea members are seeing Alfia for the first time. Riveria and Gareth explicitly have only Guild reports about the Dragon’s Urn; they share that information here. Finn had warned them of a possible greater foe.
events.uncertainty: Alfia refuses to explain her entry route. Neither the comparison with Floor 52 nor the briefing establishes that these adventurers have personally visited it.

events.title: The strike team’s sound-protection accessories are revealed in combat
events.when: Opening exchanges with Alfia on the final conflict day; manufacture preceded deployment.
events.changes: Finn commissioned Asfi to modify Silence Lyres against damaging sound. The team wears the protective piercings, but Alfia’s attacks still knock combatants down.
events.knowledge: Gareth and Lyu explain the protection to Alfia. Lyu recognizes the residual-magic detonation as an unfamiliar application of a spell key; recognition is not acquisition.
events.uncertainty: The proposed name Alfia Velador here differs from Alfia Belador later (6513). Preserve both spellings in evidence; not two proved devices or complete immunity.
events.frame: AR03 battle disclosure of previously prepared equipment

events.title: Delphyne reaches Floor 18 and Erebus names it
events.when: During the Alfia engagement, after the upward fire attack opens the floor.
events.changes: The monster emerges, attacks Erebus and kills his followers. The endangered god seeks shelter; being its summoning beneficiary does not give him safe control over it.
events.knowledge: Erebus names Delphyne and identifies its origin as divine transgression on Floor 37. Adventurers now see its destructive ascent themselves. Alfia admits she had doubted Erebus’s description.
events.uncertainty: The origin statement is Erebus’s account, not a witnessed birth scene for the adventurers. It does not name the original summoning god.
events.frame: AR03 emergence, naming and battlefield reaction

events.title: Aiz charges Delphyne and the interception party splits
events.when: Immediately after Delphyne’s arrival; before the prolonged separated battles.
events.changes: Aiz charges in rage and ignores attempts to recall her. At Alize’s urging, Riveria and Gareth leave Astrea Familia to fight Alfia and follow Aiz. Riveria first grants the Astrea members Veil Breath protection for the spell’s duration. Aiz’s expenditure exceeds what her body can sustain.
events.knowledge: Riveria and Gareth observe Delphyne regenerate wounds and scales, and recognize the need for concentrated attacks. Riveria cannot safely use her stronger attacks while Aiz is in their path.
events.uncertainty: The protection is temporary, not a permanent ability gain. Aiz incidentally protects Erebus while pursuing the monster; the text does not portray a deliberate alliance.

events.title: Astrea Familia sustains the Alfia raid with healing and supplied consumables
events.when: After Riveria and Gareth leave; before Kaguya separates to confront Vito.
events.changes: The eleven-member formation combines attacks, buffs and healing. Maryu heals Lyu, Asta and Noin; Neze, Noin and Iska administer curatives. Finn’s supplied potions, elixirs and magic potions sustain the fight. Alize uses her existing fire enchantment.
events.knowledge: Alfia recognizes the attempt to exhaust her; this is her assessment, not a newly shared party secret.
events.uncertainty: Repeated treatment does not establish an injury-free party or inexhaustible supplies. Display of an existing spell does not date its acquisition.
events.frame: AR03 ongoing raid and immediate healing

events.title: Kaguya holds off Vito separately with the reforged Higanbana
events.when: During the Alfia raid; after the earlier Alfia encounter shattered Higanbana and before Kaguya’s final duel outcome.
events.changes: Vito arrives with eight followers. Kaguya sends Lyra back to the main fight and defeats the followers before continuing against Vito. She wields Higanbana’s reforged successor, made from the recovered fragments of her shattered sword.
events.knowledge: Vito confirms to Kaguya that his earlier Floor 18 visit was reconnaissance for bringing a god underground. He evades her question about his present entry route. Lyra sees the new threat but is told not to distract the others.
events.uncertainty: Exact repair date and present access route remain unknown. At least one follower is knocked unconscious; do not silently record all eight as confirmed dead. Kaguya is apart from the subsequent defense explanation.
events.frame: AR03 separate duel with retrospective equipment history

events.title: Lyra identifies Alfia’s passive defense after making shield contact
events.when: During Kaguya’s separate Vito fight, before the later copied-defense shield payoff.
events.changes: Lyra makes contact with her shield and retreats. She identifies Alfia’s defense as a persistent enchantment and argues for exhausting its Mind cost. Lyu stops Alize from explaining her skill to the enemy.
events.knowledge: Nearby Astrea fighters hear Lyra’s explanation; Alize, Lyu and Neze explicitly respond. Alfia’s gestures had concealed the passive defense as rapid spellcasting. Alize names Rubrud Beckia but its full mechanism is not disclosed here.
events.uncertainty: Do not assign this hearing to Kaguya, Riveria or Gareth across the separated battlefield. An attrition plan is not proof that Alfia actually reaches Mind Down at this point.
events.frame: AR03 observed contact and local tactical disclosure

events.title: Noir, Dyne and Bahra die buying time for the defenders
events.when: AR03 final day, before Ottar’s victory and Level Seven update.
events.changes: Bahra and Dyne fall; fatally wounded Noir makes a final explosive charge. The veterans cannot participate afterward.
events.knowledge: Finn and Raul witness the loss; Finn refuses to strip the stronghold defenses for an impossible rescue.
events.uncertainty: The bought time is approximately a minute at best, not a precise battle stopwatch.

events.title: Ottar defeats Zald and is updated to Level Seven
events.when: AR03 final conflict day, after the duel and before the remaining urban fighting ends.
events.changes: Zald is dead; Freya updates the wounded Ottar to Seven; he destroys the approaching monsters.
events.knowledge: Falgar identifies the Level Seven power in front of witnesses.
events.uncertainty: Physical wounds are visible at the update; promotion is not a statement that all injuries heal.

events.title: Bringar kill Basram, but his control staff survives
events.when: Final conflict day, in the Amphitheatrum battle after Ottar’s victory turns the tide.
events.changes: Basram loses his arm, transforms himself and is killed. An officer retrieves the staff; four surviving spirit warriors later obey it.
events.knowledge: The brothers understand the staff’s control function. Its recovery prevents treating Basram’s death as the removal of every spirit warrior.
events.uncertainty: Do not infer that all spirit warriors perish in this engagement.

events.title: Olivas retreats while the defenders cannot pursue
events.when: Final conflict day, after news of Zald’s death and before the final rout.
events.changes: Olivas leaves the battlefield under cover; defenders lack the forces to pursue while holding the strongholds.
events.knowledge: Falgar sees the retreat; Asfi recognizes the constraint imposed by casualties and remaining enemies.
events.uncertainty: This records the immediate retreat, not a precise later hiding place or final fate.

events.title: The Dis sisters trade ability scores while Hedin and Hegni are injured
events.when: Final surface battle, before the elves respond to news of Ottar’s victory.
events.changes: The sisters remain Level Five while their complementary curse-enhanced performance approaches two Level Sixes. Dialv Stige transfers half the touched target’s Strength and Agility to Dina, compensating with her Defense and Magic. Hedin and Hegni are wounded; Hegni’s Dáinsleif has worn off.
events.knowledge: Hedin and Hegni recognize a stronger version of the curse from previous combat. Their suspicion about how it improved is not independently proven by this exchange.
events.uncertainty: This is temporary redistribution, not permanent promotion or a newly acquired curse. AR03 5191 attributes the lost spectacles to Hegni, while surrounding dialogue and character context suggest Hedin; preserve the printed anomaly rather than silently correcting quotation.

events.title: Hedin and Hegni exchange weapons and kill Dina and Vena
events.when: After hearing Ottar’s victory cheers, before the wall reinforcement reversal.
events.changes: Hedin uses Hegni’s Victim Abyss to interrupt Vena’s spell. Hegni uses Hedin’s Dizaria and endures friendly fire from Valiant Hildr to kill Dina. Vena survives the first explosion through her transferred Defense, then Hedin kills her with Valiant Hildr.
events.knowledge: The two elves coordinate despite their rivalry. Dina wrongly anticipates Caurus Hildr; the actual spell is Valiant Hildr. The scene does not establish reconciliation or affection between the surviving elves.
events.uncertainty: Weapon exchange is tactical use, not permanent transfer of ownership. Return time is unshown. Do not kill Vena at the first apparent fatal blow or infer the deaths of Apate and Alecto from the subsequent cultist reaction.

events.title: Artemis Familia arrives from outside Orario and seizes the eastern walls
events.when: Final conflict day, after a march described as five days and five nights.
events.changes: Artemis and her followers stop the wall forces from reinforcing the assault, capture the eastern walls and continue around the city. Their strongest followers are Level Two; Artemis leads personally.
events.knowledge: Hermes sees their arrival. The enemy’s earlier assumption that no useful external aid would come is disproved.
events.uncertainty: The reported march is local elapsed travel, not an exact departure hour. Their dialogue leaves other regions to the School District; it does not show every School District operation. No film-only events imported.
events.frame: AR03 final-day reinforcement with prior assumptions recalled

events.title: Astrea reaches Erebus underground with Hermes’s outside followers
events.when: During the final-day battles on Floor 18; before Alfia’s death and the Status updates.
events.changes: Hermes supplies outside followers to escort Astrea. They defeat Erebus’s remaining guards. Astrea refrains from killing him underground and stays to watch the battle.
events.knowledge: Erebus confirms to Astrea the medicinal purposes of the Dedyne plant and holy-tree branches. This is a separate confirmation from the girls’ earlier briefing.
events.uncertainty: The precise route and journey duration are not specified here. Astrea’s statement that the Dungeon would devour a dying god is attributed to her; no such death occurs in this scene.
events.frame: AR03 intercut divine encounter and battle

events.title: Lyu rejects abandoning the inherited past and the Familia renews its vow
events.when: During the final Alfia battle, before her illness becomes overt.
events.changes: Lyu admits uncertainty about justice while rejecting Alfia’s proposed return to the ancient world. Her companions rise and renew their oath; Maryu casts healing magic.
events.knowledge: Alfia and the gathered companions hear Lyu’s answer. Her loyalty to Ardee’s legacy is expressed without claiming to have solved every moral question.
events.uncertainty: An emotional turning point does not eliminate future doubt. The healing action does not establish full replenishment or make later exhaustion inconsistent.

events.title: Kaguya defeats Vito, severs his arm and returns wounded to her companions
events.when: Final-day Floor 18 battle, after Lyu’s declaration and before Alfia’s defeat.
events.changes: Kaguya uses Five Lights, severs Vito’s left arm and wounds his back and shoulder, then dispels the final attack before it reaches his heart. She leaves him to perish and returns to the Alfia fight, still wounded.
events.knowledge: Kaguya addresses Vito; narration supplies the Gojouno clan’s inherited skill/spell history. That exposition is not automatically spoken to Vito or Lyu.
events.uncertainty: Vito is not confirmed dead. Neither Five Lights nor Higanbana is newly acquired in this fight; no exact healing completion is provided.
events.frame: AR03 concurrent duel with historical clan exposition

events.title: Finn retains tactical judgment under Hell Finegas and wounds Valletta
events.when: Final-day surface pursuit after his mentors’ deaths and the turning of the battle.
events.changes: Finn delegates command to Asfi and Shakti, defeats the ambush and remaining spirit warriors, and pierces Valletta’s shoulder. She falls into Daedalus Street. He stops pursuit to resume command; his eyes return blue.
events.knowledge: Finn says he has just discovered that intense anger can let him break through the spell’s madness. Valletta sees her assumed tactical advantage fail.
events.uncertainty: Hell Finegas’s level-comparable enhancement is not Finn’s permanent Level Six update. This exceptional clarity is not proof the spell never impairs judgment. Valletta survives; no completed execution or full recovery.

events.title: Alfia’s illness becomes disabling; she rejects the offer to surrender
events.when: Late in the final Alfia battle, after the prebattle briefing but before her ultimate spell.
events.changes: Alfia fails to cast, coughs blood and becomes progressively weaker. The girls ask her to surrender; she refuses and challenges them to become heroes.
events.knowledge: The girls recognize confirmation of the earlier illness briefing. Alfia mentions her lost twin; the narrator explains Gif Blessing’s mechanism. This is not disclosure of Bell’s parentage.
events.uncertainty: Narrative estimates of Level Five or even Four describe declining fighting capacity, not a Status demotion. Her illness does not make the remaining battle harmless.
events.frame: AR03 present illness with earlier briefing recalled

events.title: Lyra spends the copied barrier; Alfia leaves her final charge and dies
events.when: End of the Alfia fight, before the eleven promotions and Delphyne victory.
events.changes: Lyra’s shield neutralizes Genos Angelus by releasing Silentium Eden copied earlier in the same fight; the shield shatters. The combined follow-up defeats Alfia. She asks them to gather hope and raise the final hero, then enters the burning pit and dies.
events.knowledge: Lyra explains the device after using it: Asfi and Cyclops built it from a design Hermes supplied based on Zeus’s Aegis. Lyu hears Alfia’s farewell and believes she hears her sister’s name; no nephew identity is disclosed.
events.uncertainty: The new shield is not the original Aegis. Its breakage prevents later reuse. The final charge is not a prophecy giving Lyu Bell’s name or future identity.
events.frame: AR03 battle conclusion with shield preparation recalled

events.title: Alfia is defeated; Astrea Familia ranks up before fighting Delphyne
events.when: Final conflict day (AR local day 7).
events.changes: Alfia dies; all eleven Astrea members reach Level Four before joining the Delphyne battle. After Alfia’s death all eleven are exhausted, supplies depleted and Maryu near Mind exhaustion. Astrea brings eleven elixirs before the update and renewed assault; the promotion alone is not presented as their recovery mechanism.
events.knowledge: Astrea announces the fresh update to allies.
events.uncertainty: Do not give those Level Four stats to their earlier Alfia fight.

events.title: Lyu and Alize persuade the injured Aiz to cooperate against Delphyne
events.when: After Astrea Familia’s update and before the final Delphyne assault.
events.changes: Aiz has open wounds, torn muscles and a displaced finger she resets herself; Desperate is cracked. Lyu rebukes her and Alize appeals to those who care for her. Aiz turns off the black wind and accepts teamwork.
events.knowledge: Aiz sees Riveria and Gareth protecting her. Lyu’s muttered allusion to their old fight is not understood by Aiz.
events.uncertainty: A situational acceptance of help is not permanent resolution of Aiz’s hatred. The source attributes the question at 7193 to Alize although surrounding context points toward Aiz; it is not used to invent a separate action. No immediate complete healing or weapon repair.
events.frame: AR03 transition into the Delphyne raid

events.title: The combined force destroys Delphyne; victory news reaches the city
events.when: Final conflict day, after the Astrea Familia updates; by the sunset ending the worst fighting.
events.changes: Allies expose the magic stone and Aiz shatters it; Delphyne disintegrates. Erebus is in custody. Survivors remain battered, while remaining Evils flee or hide.
events.knowledge: News of the deaths of Delphyne and Alfia and Erebus’s capture spreads to surface defenders. This does not disclose Erebus’s private motive.
events.uncertainty: No instant full recovery, total enemy extermination or exact hour inferred.
events.frame: AR03 historical climax and public aftermath

events.title: Vito survives his defeat and secretly reaches Babel’s rooftop
events.when: After the battles, before Erebus’s rooftop confession and return to heaven.
events.changes: Vito escapes through his hidden passage and reaches Babel with wounds only partly healed. His severed arm is still missing and he is still bleeding.
events.knowledge: He comes to question Erebus’s apparent wish that he live, and overhears the rooftop conversation from hiding.
events.uncertainty: The healing method and full recovery date are not supplied. His arrival does not mean the public learns the private confession.

events.title: Erebus explains his true aim to Astrea, Hermes and the hidden Vito
events.when: After the Great Conflict’s decisive battles.
events.changes: The cost and purpose of the trial are acknowledged.
events.knowledge: Hermes and Astrea hear the explanation; “only the gods knew” restricts covenant/promised-time knowledge. Vito overhears the whole confession from hiding and Erebus acknowledges him. His hearing the covenant allusion does not establish that he understands the gods’ private referent. Hermes explicitly agrees to secrecy.
events.uncertainty: This disclosure is not a blanket revelation to the combatants.
events.frame: AR03 conclusion, distinct from the earlier planning in its Extra

events.title: Astrea sends Erebus to heaven; Vito and Valletta remain alive
events.when: Final conflict night, after the private rooftop disclosure.
events.changes: Astrea executes the divine judgment and Erebus returns to heaven. Vito escapes through the waterways; Valletta remains in the man-made labyrinth with her shoulder wound and vow of revenge.
