events.knowledge: The city sees the pillar of light and celebrates. Hermes promises to keep the rooftop confession out of the histories. Erebus explicitly includes Vito among its witnesses.
events.uncertainty: The public outcome does not reveal the secret motive. Hermes’s promise to forget is a secrecy commitment, not demonstrated magical memory erasure. The war ends without exterminating every enemy.
events.frame: AR03 public judgment and private fugitive aftermath

events.title: The Great Conflict produces further promotions
events.when: At or around the Great Conflict seven years before the memorial; exact update days unspecified.
events.changes: Hermes reports the trio reaching Six and Aiz Four around that time; other Freya elites also reach Six.
events.knowledge: Bell hears these historical promotions in the later memorial frame.
events.uncertainty: Not an enumerated promotion roster for every Freya member.
events.frame: AR03 contemporary memorial narration about seven years earlier

events.title: Lefiya enters the School District and receives Falna
events.when: School entry before the first promotion and Loki recruitment; SO13 puts three years before first Orario arrival, while SO06 describes an additional school year after Two.
events.changes: Lefiya passes the admission interview, receives her uniform and Falna, joins Balder Class and becomes Alisa’s roommate.
events.knowledge: Her stated aim is to discover the world and what she can become; she has not yet chosen Loki Familia as a career.
events.uncertainty: No exact birth date, admission age or calendar date is derived; receiving Falna is separate from later combat training.

events.title: Olivas engineers the Twenty-Seventh-Floor Nightmare
events.when: About six years before SO03; six-year historical anchor repeated in SO07 and SO12.
events.changes: False reports draw adventurers to Floor 27; sacrificial pass parades unleash monsters including the floor boss. Both sides suffer heavy losses.
events.knowledge: Survivor accounts circulate, but the later spirit transformations and hidden purpose are not thereby known to the public.
events.uncertainty: Do not equate this with the seven-year Great Conflict or the later Juggernaut disaster. No complete casualty census or exact calendar date.

events.title: Finn attacks Evils bases during the Nightmare and seals enemy blessings
events.when: During the Floor 27 crisis, while the trapped parties are belowground.
events.changes: Finn judges there is insufficient time to aid Floor 27 and leads attacks on vulnerable surface bases with Freya and Ganesha forces. Many enemy gods return to heaven, sealing their followers’ blessings.
events.knowledge: Valletta later describes the resulting danger in the Dungeon. The exact intelligence source Finn used is unnamed.
events.uncertainty: Concurrent with TL-0371, not a wholly subsequent operation. No complete returned-god roster or claim all Evils lose Falna simultaneously.

events.title: Valletta and other Evils leaders fake their deaths and go underground
events.when: During and after the Nightmare six years before SO07.
events.changes: Evils leaders use the massacre and apparent corpses to conceal their survival. Reports of Valletta’s body mislead the Guild, though Finn retains suspicion.
events.knowledge: Finn’s suspicion is not confirmation until the later encounter. Gareth and Riveria hear the reported death; they are not eyewitnesses to an actual death.
events.uncertainty: No complete survivor list or claim every corpse is fabricated. Later survival does not undo genuine deaths.
events.frame: SO07 admission and SO08 leaders’ review

events.title: The corrupted spirit transforms the mortally wounded Olivas
events.when: On the Nightmare day, after his mutilation; the same day as Filvis’s transformation.
events.changes: A root implants a colored stone in the ruined Olivas, restoring him in a human-monster body. The original reported remains no longer establish that he stays dead.
events.knowledge: Olivas later calls this death and rebirth; narration shows his approach to death and transformation. Filvis is kept ignorant of his survival.
events.uncertainty: Preserve the brink-of-death wording alongside his claim of revival. This does not establish universal resurrection rules or a new Falna promotion.
events.frame: SO03 transformation flashback, qualified by SO12 retrospective confirmation

events.title: Filvis returns to defend her companions, dies and becomes a creature
events.when: During the Nightmare, on the same day Olivas becomes a creature.
events.changes: Filvis turns back at her captain’s plea, is killed and transformed. Her party’s other implanted bodies fail to become coherent creatures. She returns to Rivira in despair.
events.knowledge: The rumor that she simply abandoned her friends is corrected only in SO12’s confession. Earlier witnesses see her distress without knowing its cause.
events.uncertainty: The deployed party is lost; this is not proof every person affiliated with Dionysus anywhere dies that day. Do not assign the later truth to Bors at first sight.

events.title: Filvis develops cloning magic after her transformation
events.when: After becoming a creature; exact acquisition and first successful use unplaced.
events.changes: Regeneration and the controlling stone prevent Filvis from ending her life. She hears the spirit’s voice and develops cloning magic after the transformation.
events.knowledge: Her private suffering and spell are not public knowledge. Later observers initially know only her lightning and barrier spells.
events.uncertainty: The proposed emotional explanation is tentative. Do not make the spell available before the Nightmare or date acquisition to its later reveal.
events.frame: SO12 testimony about earlier private changes

events.title: Dionysus exploits Filvis’s despair to enlist her in his plan
events.when: After Filvis’s transformation and despair; before her sustained work for Enyo.
events.changes: Dionysus professes love and promises a world where others are transformed like Filvis. She accepts his plan as her remaining path and serves him.
events.knowledge: Loki later hears his version separately from Lefiya’s hearing of Filvis’s confession. His claims of salvation are manipulation, not evidence of a benevolent plan.
events.uncertainty: No exact interval after the Nightmare. Her later care for Lefiya does not mean she had already repudiated Dionysus.
events.frame: SO12 parallel confessions about earlier coercion

events.title: Enyo unites the corrupted spirit’s forces with Evils remnants
events.when: Concrete preparations begin six years before SO12, after the Nightmare reveals the spirit.
events.changes: Using Filvis to contact Revis and the spirit, Dionysus negotiates cooperation and joins the underground forces to surviving Evils while keeping his identity hidden.
events.knowledge: Knowledge of the alliance does not establish that every subordinate knows Enyo is Dionysus.
events.uncertainty: This is the operational alliance, not the fifteen-year origin of his ambition. No exact contract date or exhaustive chain of command.
events.frame: SO12 final confrontation reconstructs earlier alliance

events.title: The twins join Loki Familia; Tione falls for Finn
events.when: Five years before SO06’s contemporary explanation.
events.changes: Finn defeats Tione; Gareth defeats Tiona; the sisters join. Tione’s attraction begins and grows afterward.
events.knowledge: Loki and leaders hear about the sisters’ killing past at recruitment.
events.uncertainty: Do not make Tione’s later mannerisms or affection part of her pre-Finn characterization.

events.title: The twins’ first Loki expedition brings Level Four and new bonds
events.when: After joining Loki Familia; precise update day unknown.
events.changes: First expedition leads both sisters to Level Four; Tione changes her manners; Tiona gradually befriends Aiz.
events.knowledge: Lefiya joins the friendship group later in this compressed retrospective.
events.uncertainty: No date assigned to Lefiya’s arrival from her first mention here.

events.title: Kaguya and Lyra advise Lyu before their private toast
events.when: Before the gathering five years before FC03; two years after the Great Conflict and Adi’s death.
events.changes: Kaguya confronts Lyu over sacrifices; Lyra teaches the distinction between knowledge and wisdom. Lyu continues resisting the idea of necessary sacrifices.
events.knowledge: Alize overheard part of Kaguya’s exchange. These earlier lessons do not give Lyu knowledge of the later private gathering.
events.uncertainty: Do not backdate Lyu’s later settled answers or actual junior mentoring to these hopes and lessons.
events.frame: FC03 A Simple Moment from Five Years Ago, recalled advice within historical conversation

events.title: Alize and friends privately toast Lyu’s future
events.when: Five years before the FC03 present, per story title.
events.changes: The friends wish for Lyu to find hope. Most members are in the Dungeon; Astrea is meeting deities with Lyana and Noin as guards. This brief respite is two years after the battle, not proof the city is wholly safe.
events.knowledge: Narrator explicitly says Lyu would never know this moment.
events.frame: FC03 A Simple Moment Five Years Ago

events.title: Haruhime is disowned and handed to a visiting aristocrat
events.when: Five years before FM07, when Haruhime is eleven.
events.changes: Haruhime is accused of eating the offering, disowned and handed to the visiting aristocrat. Her childhood friends learn of her expulsion before a planned visit and fail to locate her.
events.knowledge: Haruhime has no memory of eating the offering and relies on the crumbs she found. Bell later suspects the prum’s story; that suspicion is not proof of a staged crime.
events.uncertainty: No exact birthday, named aristocrat or confirmed fraud mechanism. Haruhime’s own belief is preserved as belief.
events.frame: FM07 two retrospective accounts of the separation

events.title: Haruhime is abandoned during an attack and sold in Orario
events.when: After her disowning; before Takemikazuchi Familia’s later arrival in Orario.
events.changes: The aristocrat flees an ogre attack. Marauders save Haruhime from the monsters but then transport and sell her into the Pleasure Quarter.
events.knowledge: This is Haruhime’s account to Bell. Her friends did not know her location when searching in the Far East.
events.uncertainty: Exact sale, Ishtar conversion and magic-acquisition dates are not supplied. Do not compress an unmeasured journey into the day of expulsion.

events.title: Loki begins changing Aiz’s battle clothing at age eleven
events.when: Begins five years before the story’s present, when Aiz is eleven; later outfits accumulate over an unspecified interval.
events.changes: Loki supplies replacement clothing when Aiz outgrows earlier gear; by the framing present Aiz’s battle clothes resemble a leotard.
events.knowledge: Loki’s armor claims are her sales pitch; the text does not enumerate tested defensive properties.
events.uncertainty: Present frame lacks a specific main-series day. Proposed bunny suit is not confirmed acquired; the next-day assault on Loki does not identify an assailant.
events.frame: SS02 Dress-Up Aiz, five-years-earlier start, wardrobe montage, then undated present

events.title: Astrea Familia is destroyed by the earlier Juggernaut
events.when: Five years before FM14’s contemporary Juggernaut crisis.
events.changes: Lyu is the surviving member; later vengeance and estrangement follow.
events.knowledge: Later narrations disclose history to the reader; Bell’s specific learning requires its own scene.
events.uncertainty: Not the seven-years-earlier Great Conflict; the two disasters must not be merged.

events.title: Lyu reports the massacre and persuades Astrea to leave Orario
events.when: After the Juggernaut loss; Lyu pleads for days before Astrea leaves.
events.changes: Unable to retrieve the bodies, Lyu gathers keepsakes for the Floor 18 graves. She reports the losses and begs Astrea to leave, later explaining that she did not want her goddess to witness the violence she intended.
events.knowledge: Astrea hears Lyu’s account before departing. Bell hears this explanation only in the later Floor 18 conversation.
events.uncertainty: Days remains an unspecified interval. Lyu’s retrospective explanation is not a claim that every motive or future action was disclosed to Astrea then.
events.frame: FM05 Lyu’s testimony about the earlier loss

events.title: Lyu’s revenge leads to blacklisting and a bounty
events.when: After Astrea leaves Orario, before Lyu collapses and Syr rescues her.
events.changes: Lyu destroys the offending Familia through ambushes and attacks, extending her violence to suspected associates. The Guild blacklists her; a bounty is raised. Astrea’s departure leaves her Status intact.
events.knowledge: Lyu later condemns these acts as vengeance rather than justice when explaining them to Bell.
events.uncertainty: The wording about eliminating her targets does not prove every Evils remnant everywhere was exterminated. A complete victim roster and campaign duration remain unknown.
events.frame: FM05 retrospective testimony, not a contemporary public confession

events.title: Syr rescues Lyu and arranges her tavern employment
events.when: After Lyu collapses at the end of her revenge campaign.
events.changes: Syr finds Lyu in an alley, listens repeatedly and brings her back from despair. Syr persuades Mia to employ her; Lyu keeps her hair dyed to reduce recognition.
events.knowledge: Syr learns Lyu’s account. Lyu does not thereby learn Syr’s divine identity.
events.uncertainty: No exact recovery duration or first-shift date. Protection from recognition is a precaution, not perfect anonymity or restored Guild standing.
events.frame: FM05 retrospective account of rescue and employment

events.title: Astrea establishes her Solingen home while Lyu remains estranged
events.when: After leaving Orario five years before FC03; new members gathered by the current visit.
events.changes: Astrea has new followers; Lyu’s bond is not erased. Hermes carries Lyu’s letters.
events.knowledge: Lyu did not know Astrea’s location during the letter-carrying period.
events.uncertainty: Exact recruitment dates of the new members are unplaced.
events.frame: FC03 contemporary reunion explains five-year separation

events.title: Astrea mediates between Solingen and its angered spirits
events.when: Five years before the FC03 visit, after leaving Orario.
events.changes: Astrea averts the city’s destruction; resource use becomes managed and smiths provide annual offerings and entertainment. Her home watches over the forest.
events.knowledge: Iselina tells Lyu this on her fourth Solingen day; Astrea subsequently acknowledges the incident.
events.uncertainty: Iselina reports local history; no exact calendar date or complete terms of the settlement are supplied.
events.frame: FC03 fourth-day conversation recalls historical intervention

events.title: Demeter updates Runoa and offers her a farming life
events.when: Evening during the Girl Meets Girls surveillance period, before its confrontation.
events.changes: Demeter updates the already Level Four Runoa and offers her work and belonging. Runoa declines, feeling her violent past would taint them, and plans to retire after one last job.
events.knowledge: Demeter hears Runoa describe her work in violence; no complete target list is disclosed. Runoa’s retirement is still an intention.
events.uncertainty: An ordinary update is not a new promotion. A declined invitation is not completed agricultural employment.

events.title: Cecille joins Astrea for the weapon commission and the Solingen household grows
events.when: Commission five years before Lyu’s visit; subsequent recruitment and Cecille’s Level Two occur before that visit.
events.changes: Cecille is the first new recruit and later captain. A cabin gives way to Stars’ Rest and her workshop as others join. She attains Level Two during this interval.
events.knowledge: Lyu learns Cecille’s captaincy on the second evening; Cecille reveals the five-year commission and her initial motives on the fourth night.
events.uncertainty: Do not grant Cecille Smithing or Level Two immediately at recruitment. Hephaistos’s refusal and the family’s motives are not the same disclosure; the father explains himself later.
events.frame: FC03 second-evening explanation and fourth-night personal account

events.title: Njörðr updates Chloe and offers her a place among his followers
events.when: During the same historical surveillance period as Runoa’s Demeter visit, before the tavern confrontation.
events.changes: Already Level Four, Chloe receives an ordinary update. Njörðr recognizes her exhaustion and offers fuller participation in his Familia; she cannot see herself accepting and speaks of not knowing how to make friends.
events.knowledge: Njörðr knows Black Cat’s identity and has kept it secret. The private conversation is not automatically known to Lyu or the other tavern women.
events.uncertainty: The offer is not a new Falna conversion or completed move to Meren. Her wish for companions develops before the later confrontation, not after every friendship is already settled.

events.title: Thanatos gathers surviving Evils over the following five years
events.when: Across the five years before SO07, after previous patrons are lost and defeats suffered.
events.changes: Thanatos gathers displaced followers including Valletta and rebuilds the remnant organization. He later recalls their defeat five years earlier.
events.knowledge: Lefiya learns his stated leadership during the SO07 encounter. That does not disclose Enyo’s true identity.
events.uncertainty: The earlier six-year concealment and later five-year defeat/regrouping coexist. This is not evidence that every survivor follows the same path or that all divine conversions are simultaneous.
events.frame: SO07 explanation of ongoing historical regrouping

events.title: The tavern girls’ historical confrontation ends under Mia’s protection
events.when: FC01 Girl Meets Girls past sequence; its ending looks forward five years to another Bruno confrontation.
events.changes: Mia protects the wanted women’s identities and compels tavern work.
events.knowledge: Bruno figures know the wanted identities and are silenced; public Guild knowledge is not established.
events.uncertainty: Chloe/Runoa arrival wording elsewhere in the episode requires care: do not force all relative years into one date.
events.frame: FC01 second story historical scene with explicit future aside

events.title: Eina enters Guild employment after School District study
events.when: Age fourteen at employment; no exact birthday or calendar year assigned.
events.changes: School recommendation leads to Guild employment; Eina begins advising adventurers, first Maris. Rehmer later says Eina and Misha both started a year earlier; their shared employment interval is explicit.
events.knowledge: Her motives include supporting her frequently ill mother and broadening her horizons.
events.uncertainty: Family background is narrator exposition, not a disclosure to Bell.

events.title: Maris becomes Eina’s first adventurer casualty
events.when: One year after Eina became an adviser.
events.changes: Eina identifies Maris’s body and experiences the death of someone close.
events.knowledge: The returning adventurers speculate about an infant dragon and possible recklessness; neither cause is confirmed by Eina witnessing the raid.
events.uncertainty: Do not convert the speculation about the fatal encounter into a witnessed fact.

events.title: Repeated losses reshape Eina’s advising practice
events.when: After Maris’s death; develops over subsequent days and losses.
events.changes: Shared grief lets Eina mourn; she chooses deeper involvement and rigorous instruction instead of full emotional withdrawal.
events.knowledge: These are described choices at this stage, not a universal personality rule.
events.uncertainty: No exact date for the completed change in outlook.

events.title: Aisha destroys the first Killing Stone and is punished
events.when: Three years before FM07’s ritual night; after the ritual building was constructed five years earlier.
events.changes: Aisha destroys the first Killing Stone. Phryne nearly kills her and Ishtar uses Charm and threats against the younger Berbera to inhibit further resistance. The ritual is delayed until another stone is obtained.
events.knowledge: Aisha and her punishers know what occurred; Haruhime’s later surprised reaction shows the event cannot simply be treated as shared knowledge from the start.
events.uncertainty: Aisha retains free will despite fear and Charm. Do not treat her as an automaton or assume every Berbera has identical knowledge.
events.frame: FM07 retrospective disclosure and corroborating narration

events.title: Bell hears his grandfather’s stories and advice about pursuing girls
events.when: Bell’s childhood before becoming an adventurer; no exact age or year established.
events.changes: Bell associates hero stories with his grandfather’s advice, while not yet understanding the word harem.
events.knowledge: The child hears the advice but does not understand every adult term. No ancestry or divine identity disclosure occurs in this recollection.
events.uncertainty: Do not project the recalled childish misunderstanding onto every later stage of Bell’s outlook; no exact birth date or childhood age derived.
events.frame: SS01 Tutorial opens with Bell’s childhood recollection before the registration scene

events.title: Lefiya reaches Two while at school; accounts differ in proximity to Orario arrival
events.when: SO13 associates Two with arrival after three years of school; SO06 places Two after three years, followed by another school year before conversion.
events.changes: Repeated adventures bring the four classmates into a squad. Lefiya develops her magic and reaches Two before joining Loki Familia. She is still seeking a future direction when the ship reaches Orario.
events.knowledge: Her friends’ career ambitions are known to her; their plans are not yet completed appointments.
events.uncertainty: SO13’s around-the-time association is looser; do not silently erase either account or turn rounded years into exact dates.
events.frame: SO13 compressed school development and arrival

events.title: Aiz reaches Level Five three years before the opening expedition update
events.when: Three years before the SO01 post-expedition Status update.
events.changes: Aiz has attained Five and remains there until the separately recorded Six update. By SO01 she feels stalled despite her recent expedition.
events.knowledge: The current update shows her limited gains; the desire for further growth belongs to this later scene.
events.uncertainty: No calendar anniversary, acquisition date for every displayed development ability, or claim that her frustration remained constant throughout those years.
events.frame: SO01 current Status scene with historical promotion recalled

events.title: Lefiya converts from Balder to Loki after School District recruitment
events.when: The prior School District visit, roughly three years before her SO13 return.
events.changes: A recommended student and sole accepted applicant among eight hundred, Lefiya becomes Loki Familia’s first recruit from the School District. She converts from Balder at Level Two; Alicia and Anakitty served as the recruiters on that visit.
events.knowledge: Lefiya sees the gods’ tense relationship and is unsettled by Loki’s response to her teasing question. This is separate from later learning to handle Loki’s antics.
events.uncertainty: No exact conversion day or later Level Three update date. Eight hundred applicants is the Loki selection pool, not the earlier School District entrance-exam pool.
events.frame: SO13 present recruitment discussion and conversion recollection

events.title: Bell’s believed bereavement differs from Hermes’s later account
events.when: Believed death about a year before the opening; its falsity is disclosed to Hestia during FM05.
events.changes: Bell grows up believing his grandfather died.
events.knowledge: Hermes later tells Hestia the death was faked; Bell is not told by this exchange.
events.uncertainty: The belief and the later correction are separate knowledge stages; no exact departure date.
events.frame: FM01 remembered loss; FM05 later private disclosure

events.title: Takemikazuchi’s strongest shrine children move to Orario to support their home
events.when: About two years before FM07; after Haruhime has reached Orario.
events.changes: The oldest children able to fight travel with Takemikazuchi to earn money and send support home as more orphans strain the shrine’s resources.
events.knowledge: Their presence in the same city does not establish that they know Haruhime is there.
events.uncertainty: No exact crossing duration or date for the first remittance.
events.frame: FM07 Mikoto’s explanation to Bell, Lilly and Welf

events.title: Hestia’s descent, eviction and church lodging precede Bell
events.when: Roughly half a year from descent to meeting Bell; three months before eviction and three afterward.
events.changes: Hestia initially lodges with Hephaistos, is evicted, and receives the church basement as shelter.
events.uncertainty: Months remain months; the basement move is after eviction without an exact moving day.

events.title: Lefiya reaches Three one year after joining Loki
events.when: One year after Loki conversion and two years before SO06’s post-expedition update.
events.changes: Lefiya reaches Three after accumulating S-rank Magic at Two. SO06 separately says her first promotion took three years, at eleven, followed by one further school year before conversion.
events.knowledge: Loki and Lefiya discuss the earlier Magic rank when deciding whether to delay the next promotion.
events.uncertainty: These year intervals do not establish a precise birthday or global day.
events.frame: SO06 Status conversation recalling earlier growth

events.title: Ali grows up publicly as Prince Aram; Warsa takes her capital
events.when: Before Freya meets Ali; childhood and recent invasion are separate intervals.
events.changes: Ali is raised as the male royal heir under the public name Aram; Ali is her real name. Her mother dies during childhood. After Solshana falls and her father is executed, she escapes and deliberately allows slavers to capture her as cover.
events.knowledge: A limited set of retainers knows the concealed identity; public princehood does not mean universal knowledge.
events.uncertainty: The reported age sixteen is not an exact birth date. No exact year is assigned to childhood losses or an unshown coronation.
events.frame: FC02 present disclosures and narrator’s retrospective royal history

events.title: Freya leaves Orario for the Kaios Desert and her eight guards catch up
events.when: Spring in full swing; before the desert encounter with Ali.
events.changes: Freya obtains departure permission by threatening Royman with an unspecified secret. Her followers find her after her departure; Bofman guides her in the desert.
events.knowledge: Royman is told he may claim she enthralled him; this is a cover story, not proof she actually charmed him.
events.uncertainty: Spring is established but not an exact year or day. The journey’s total duration is not stated.
events.frame: FC02 Ali and the 8 Followers, opening journey

events.title: Freya buys and frees Leodo’s slaves and makes a bargain with Bofman
events.when: Leodo arrival and the subsequent feast, before Ali’s private disclosure.
events.changes: Freya buys all the offered slaves and a mansion. Bofman advances funds in exchange for a promised future business relationship with her Familia. Yona and Haara are told to work with Bofman; future welcome in Orario is conditional.
events.knowledge: Narration distinguishes voluntary attraction from active enthrallment. The liberated people are not thereby granted Falna.
events.uncertainty: Not abolition of the town’s slave trade; not completed conversion, universal employment or a fulfilled later welcome.

events.title: Freya exposes Ali’s royal identity to Bofman and claims a travelling companion
events.when: The first Leodo night; departure the next morning.
events.changes: Ali confirms that she is Prince Aram. Freya releases her and then takes repayment in the form of accompanying her journey; she promises not to interfere.
events.knowledge: Bofman learns the prince is female in this private exchange. Ali gives Freya her real name and the plan to meet retainers at a hidden fortress.
events.uncertainty: No public disclosure of the secret; the promise does not mean Freya never intervenes later.
events.frame: FC02 private identity disclosure and next-morning departure

events.title: Ali’s first travel day brings a rupture with Allen and Freya’s Odr explanation
events.when: First day after leaving Leodo; oasis camp that night.
events.changes: Ali has sword training but no Falna. Her insult provokes Allen to violence; the others restrain him and Freya stops it. Hegni takes over protection. Ali later apologizes to Freya and speaks about her doubts as a ruler.
events.knowledge: Ali hears Freya’s search for Odr and that she is a candidate. She has not yet witnessed Freya’s active charm.
events.uncertainty: This begins a change in outlook, not instant removal of every doubt or friendship with Allen.

events.title: Ali finds her retainers dead and returns to a burned Leodo; Freya uses charm
events.when: Fortress reached three days after departure; return journey takes a few hours and ends before sunrise.
events.changes: The fortress retainers are dead. Leodo is burning; Yona, Haara and the freed slaves have been killed. Freya charms the attacking group and orders their deaths. Allen shields Ali’s eyes and ears during the command.
events.knowledge: Ali sees the result and hears Allen explain charm. The reader separately sees Resheph ordering expansion into Israfan; that scene is not a disclosure to Ali.
events.uncertainty: Do not equate deaths of the freed group with every inhabitant of Leodo dying. Freya’s stated reasons for avoiding charm are not an inviolable future restriction.
events.frame: FC02 intercut enemy planning, fortress discovery and Leodo return

events.title: Ali wins Freya’s Halvan wager and receives temporary command of eight followers
events.when: Night following a day inspecting Leodo; the text calls this the day after the attack.
events.changes: Freya rejects Ali’s transactional offer to become Odr. In the wager Freya recognizes a winning continuation from Ali’s intuitive move, demonstrates it and resigns. She orders her eight followers to serve Ali until the desired battle is finished; Hedin becomes her adviser.
events.knowledge: The followers hear and obey the temporary command. This is not a Falna transfer or permanent change of allegiance.
events.uncertainty: Ali did not independently calculate the whole winning line. A promised reward in heaven is not shown fulfilled.
events.frame: FC02 post-raid day, wager and war council

events.title: Hedin stages Leodo’s rescue; Ali broadcasts the call for battle
events.when: Morning rescue after the war council; speech the following day, calling for battle five days hence.
events.changes: The brothers funnel two enemy squads into a public rescue performed by Ottar and Allen. Ali publicly identifies herself as Aram and mobilizes Shalzad through merchants.
events.knowledge: The audience does not know the rescue was staged. The invented founder Ali is a coded authenticity signal recognized by retainers who know her secret; the speech does not publicly announce her sex.
events.uncertainty: The public claim that Aram left the capital to recruit heroes is Hedin’s constructed account, not the actual escape history.
events.frame: FC02 staged rescue, speech and retrospective explanation of its planning

events.title: Ali apologizes to Allen and hears his account of abandoning his sister
events.when: Night before the decisive battle.
events.changes: Ali thanks the followers and separately apologizes to Allen. She considers leaving her country; she privately tells Freya she sees something of her mother in her and wants her love.
events.knowledge: Allen tells Ali he abandoned his sister for Freya. After he leaves Ali, Freya calls him a liar and says he still cares about Anya. Ali is not shown hearing that correction or learning the sister’s name here.
events.uncertainty: Allen’s self-description is not proof he no longer loves Anya. Ali’s feelings are described as mixed; do not reduce the conversation to a single universal relationship label.
events.frame: FC02 private conversations on the battle’s eve

events.title: Eight Freya adventurers defeat Warsa in the Sindh Expanse
events.when: The appointed battle day, five days after Ali’s speech; the actual fighting is in Sindh, not the announced Gazoob gathering place.
events.changes: Eight followers meet an eighty-thousand army split into divisions. Hedin uses Caurus Hildr and Dizaria; Hegni uses Victim Abyss and Dáinsleif. The latter changes his personality, not his Status. The brothers encircle the reserves; Allen’s running raises a sandstorm.
events.knowledge: Ali observes the battle separately from Freya. Later historical narration identifies Orcas as a survivor and historian; this is not information everyone knows during the battle.
events.uncertainty: Equipment and magic are attested in use, not acquired here. Total extermination is the plan, not the result; survivors are explicit. Future fame and tactical scholarship must not be imported into this day.
events.frame: FC02 battle intercut with a later historian’s retrospective

events.title: Seal’s curse shows Allen images of Anya; killing Seal does not immediately end it
events.when: During Allen’s fight in the Battle of the Sindh.
events.changes: Level Four Seal’s Hal Reshef makes enemies appear to Allen as his beloved sister. Allen attacks them, demands removal, then kills Seal after the failed dispelling. The illusion persists after the caster’s death.
events.knowledge: The reader learns the images are Anya; Seal cannot see who his victim sees. Anya is not physically on the battlefield and is not injured by these attacks.
events.uncertainty: Curse expiry is time-limited but no duration or on-page recovery endpoint is provided. Allen’s denunciation does not negate the narrated emotional connection.
events.frame: FC02 battle perspective, private illusion and caster’s limited knowledge

events.title: Ottar kills the basilisk and accepts surrender; Resheph escapes
events.when: End of the Sindh battle and its immediate aftermath.
events.changes: Resheph’s monster-control attempt fails and Iza dies. Ottar kills the basilisk, accepts Gorza’s surrender and explicitly refuses to kill everyone. The main division is taken prisoner. Resheph escapes; Shalzad is liberated.
events.knowledge: Resheph recognizes the pattern of the attackers only late in the battle. Ali draws a new conclusion about Orario’s restrictions from witnessing their strength.
events.uncertainty: Ottar’s sword is unnamed here: do not assign his later Supreme Black Sword. Control-device failure is narrated with a tentative explanation, not a confirmed engineering diagnosis.
events.frame: FC02 battle conclusion and dusk aftermath

events.title: Freya leaves Ali to rule Shalzad and departs with her followers
events.when: Return to Solshana and parting; Ali’s time with Freya has been less than two weeks.
events.changes: Freya rejects taking Ali as Odr and tells her to live as a king. Ali turns toward her people; Freya and all eight followers leave.
events.knowledge: Freya subsequently explains her decision to Ottar: taking Ali away would extinguish the royal brilliance that attracted her. Ali hears the rejection and injunction, not necessarily that private explanation.
events.uncertainty: No promise to meet again and no completed coronation ceremony are shown. Freya’s rationale for Ali does not prove her future treatment of Bell will follow the same rule.
events.frame: FC02 Solshana parting followed by private explanation

events.title: Overview: Freya’s desert journey, later historical framing and first sight of Bell
events.when: Before Freya’s first observation of Bell in Orario.
events.changes: Shalzad survives; Freya leaves Ali to rule and returns to Orario. During the preceding Leodo episode Freya buys and frees the city’s slaves; her watching elites discuss the cost. During the Sindh battle Hegni uses Dainsleif; narration distinguishes altered demeanor from a separate tactical mind or newly acquired magic.
events.knowledge: Her later private first sight of Bell is distinct from Syr’s first meeting with him.
events.uncertainty: Spring is explicit for departure (TL-0270), but the year and day offset to Bell remain unplaced. TL-0269–TL-0283 separate the component events. The future reign summary is not contemporaneous with return or a prerequisite to first seeing Bell.
events.frame: FC02 desert narrative followed by future historical summary and Bell-era coda

events.title: Hedin debriefs Royman after the desert return
events.when: After Freya returns from the Kaios Desert; the conversation recalls how the elites first tracked her departure.
events.changes: Hedin reports Freya’s safe return and no losses; Royman is threatened with exposure of the earlier bargain.
events.knowledge: Royman hears Hedin’s report of eight fighters destroying an army of eighty thousand before witnesses. Ouranos is threatened as a potential recipient, not shown receiving the report.
events.uncertainty: The battle numbers here are Hedin’s report, not a fresh battle or a precise casualty inventory. Relative order of this debrief and Freya first noticing Bell is not established.
events.frame: SS02 After the Desert Journey: Elven Debriefing, present report with recalled departure inquiry

events.title: Ali wakes from the imagined diplomatic summit shortly after Freya’s departure
events.when: Shortly after Freya and her followers leave the restored Shalzad; Warsa is retreating.
events.changes: Ali wakes on the recovered throne and prepares to work on restoration, encouraged by a dream of a thriving nation.
events.knowledge: Ali loses the identities and conversations from the dream; Jafar treats it as a good omen, not verified prophecy.
events.uncertainty: Dreamed Bofman level-ups, trade arrangements, meetings, Finn’s statements and Freya’s Odr message are not confirmed future facts. No excluded media supply those outcomes.
events.frame: SS02 Mirage in a Sea of Sand, historical waking frame surrounding an imagined future

events.title: Naaza loses her right arm and withdraws from monster combat
events.when: Before the FM04 potion episode; date of the accident unknown.
events.changes: Other limbs recovered; right arm replaced with a silver prosthesis. Monster-related trauma prevents her former adventuring.
events.knowledge: Bell hears the account later in TL-0137, not during the original injury.
events.uncertainty: The retained prosthesis does not prove recovery from her trauma.

events.title: Miach’s loan for Naaza’s arm precedes the other members’ departure
events.when: After the arm injury; before the contemporary FM04 financial crisis.
events.changes: Miach incurs the prosthesis debt; other followers leave; Naaza becomes a chemist.
events.uncertainty: No exact debt date, interest calendar or departure roster.

events.title: Bell registers as an adventurer and first meets Eina
events.when: Roughly two weeks before the opening rescue, according to Eina’s FM01 recollection; shortly after founding Hestia Familia.
events.changes: The Guild accepts Bell’s registration; he requests an adviser and starting equipment.
events.knowledge: Bell learns Eina’s name and receives initial Guild rules. Eina does not yet announce herself as his adviser.
events.uncertainty: The retrospective “other day” does not date Familia founding exactly; no cumulative day number assigned.
events.frame: SS01 Tutorial, early-career narrative following a childhood recollection

events.title: Eina becomes Bell’s adviser and hands over his starting equipment
events.when: The morning after Bell’s registration.
events.changes: Bell receives a shortsword and light armor to be paid off, plus a gifted backpack and leg holster. Eina begins her required lessons for her own advisees.
events.knowledge: Bell learns the gift’s status and that these intensive lessons are Eina’s practice, not a universal Guild program.
events.uncertainty: Do not treat loaned-cost equipment as paid off or Eina’s lessons as proof Bell already mastered all the material.

events.title: Hestia’s attempt to support Bell in the Dungeon ends in retreat
events.when: A week and change after Bell became an adventurer; the outing is the day after his discussion with Eina and Hestia.
events.changes: Hestia accompanies Bell as a supporter on Floor 1; both retreat exhausted and abandon the day’s haul with her backpack. Bell takes hiring a supporter more seriously.
events.knowledge: Bell asks about gods entering the Dungeon; Hestia evades rather than providing a full explanation.
events.uncertainty: The closing claim she never accompanied him again must be read cautiously alongside the later Floor 18 rescue. A distinction between routine support and rescue may explain it, but the text does not explicitly supply that qualification.
events.frame: SS01 Ace Supporter, early-career episode with a forward-looking closing assertion

events.title: Loki Familia abandons its expedition at Floor 50
events.when: Six days before its return through Floor 17, shortly before the opening rescue.
events.changes: Weapons and supplies damaged; the expedition retreats.
events.uncertainty: Not a license to place every earlier expedition scene at Day −6.

events.title: Dionysus uses divine wine to make his righteous facade convincing
events.when: Before and during the early Loki/Hermes investigation; exact start unknown.
events.changes: Dionysus voluntarily intoxicates and persuades himself that he is an ally of justice, concealing his genuine intentions while interacting with investigators.
events.knowledge: Loki and Hermes are deceived by emotions that are sincere in the intoxicated state. The method is explained only in SO12.
events.uncertainty: No claim Demeter drugged or controlled him. The text’s split-personality comparison is a description of this scheme, not a clinical diagnosis or exact onset date.
events.frame: SO12 explanation of earlier investigation behavior

events.title: Dionysus secretly converts followers to Penia through intoxication
events.when: Before the murdered followers discover the change and before the SO11 assault; exact conversion dates unknown.
events.changes: Dionysus gets Penia and his followers drunk and has Penia perform conversions while they mistake her for him. Aura and the other eventual assault participants actually bear Penia’s Falna.
events.knowledge: The converted followers do not initially recognize the substitution. The later Status seal is thus not proof of Dionysus’s death.
events.uncertainty: Filvis is excluded from this false roster. Do not infer she converted to Penia or use the first public mention as a conversion date.
events.frame: SO12 explanation of concealed membership changes

events.title: Dionysus orders three followers killed and uses their deaths as a cover story
events.when: Before the early sewer investigation; his account then dates the deaths one month earlier.
events.changes: Three followers sober during Penia’s updates and flee; Dionysus has the masked creature kill them. He presents their deaths and colored stones to Loki as a grievance tying him to Monsterphilia.
events.knowledge: The dead had recognized the conversion deception. Loki initially hears a victim story, not the true agent and motive; SO12 corrects it.
events.uncertainty: The exact dates and individual identities are not given. Do not treat the misleading revenge claim as his actual motivation.
events.frame: SO12 reconstruction quoting the earlier false account

events.title: Freya first notices Bell after returning from Kaios
events.when: After Freya’s desert return and an unspecified interval of boredom; precise relation to Bell’s opening rescue is not fixed by this passage.
events.changes: Freya is attracted to Bell’s clear soul and decides to learn about him and watch his development, modifying her approach after Ali.
events.knowledge: Freya does not yet know his name or Familia at this first sight. Her desire and plan are private; Bell learns none of them here.
events.uncertainty: No exact delay after Kaios, no automatic identification with Syr’s first spoken meeting, and no unsupported placement before Day 0.
events.frame: FC02 Bell-era coda following, but not temporally after, the entire future historical summary

events.title: Aiz saves Bell from a Minotaur
events.when: Day 0: editorial origin, the day of the opening rescue; not a calendar date.
events.changes: Bell survives; Aiz becomes the object of his aspiration.
events.knowledge: Bell sees his rescuer; this does not disclose her history.

events.title: Hestia records Bell’s rapid-growth skill and conceals it
events.when: First Status scene after the rescue.
events.changes: Rapid-growth skill is present (source calls it Realis Phrase).
events.knowledge: Hestia knows; she deliberately withholds the skill from Bell.

events.title: Bell meets Syr at the tavern
events.when: The morning after the opening rescue.
events.changes: A new acquaintance and continuing tavern connection.
events.knowledge: Bell learns the name Syr; does not learn Freya’s identity.

events.title: Bete’s tavern ridicule reaches Bell
events.when: After meeting Syr; Loki Familia’s post-expedition tavern visit.
events.changes: Bell’s humiliation is part of his drive to grow.
events.knowledge: Aiz and her companions hear Bete’s version; this is not Bell volunteering his experience.
events.uncertainty: Merged across series; no second occurrence.

events.title: Bell receives and uses the Hestia Knife
events.when: Monster Feria, after Hestia’s three-day absence.
events.changes: Bell has the growing Hestia Knife and defeats the silverback.
events.knowledge: Hephaistos explains the blade to Hestia; not every spectator knows its mechanism.

events.title: Aiz receives repaired Desperate and incurs the loaner cost
events.when: Morning after Monsterphilia; before the money-earning trip.
events.changes: Desperate is returned. The broken loaner and its replacement cost motivate another Dungeon trip.
events.uncertainty: No exact calendar date or exhaustive participant knowledge asserted.

events.title: Bell’s new armor and Eina’s armguard are in use
events.when: The armor was purchased the previous day, before the supporter work.
events.changes: Bell has new armor and the green armguard given by Eina.
events.uncertainty: Exact item-label and Babel-floor claims are not certified by this anchor.

events.title: Bell meets Lilly and begins their supporter contract
events.when: Initial street encounter and formal approach precede the next day’s first contracted work.
events.changes: Lilly becomes Bell’s hired supporter, still outside Hestia Familia.
events.knowledge: Her stated motives are not a fully trustworthy disclosure.
events.uncertainty: No exact calendar date or exhaustive participant knowledge asserted.

events.title: Lilly’s attempted knife sale fails
events.when: During the early supporter deception.
events.changes: The shop offers thirty valis for decoration; the knife is taken away unsold.
events.knowledge: The appraiser’s inability to use it does not establish its worth to Bell.
events.uncertainty: No exact calendar date or exhaustive participant knowledge asserted.

events.title: Bell and Hestia share a summer evening while still living beneath the church
events.when: During the church-home period, on a hot summer day off; no calendar date supplied.
events.changes: Bell buys a watermelon and the pair share it at the abandoned church.
events.knowledge: Their wish for a tropical trip is not a journey they actually take.
events.uncertainty: Do not place this after Freya merely from anthology ordering or use summer language to calculate exact months between arcs.
events.frame: SS01 A Slight Summer Shade, undated church-era scene

events.title: Amid delivers the Unicorn’s Cup after a three-day quest
events.when: Day after turning in the unicorn quest; three days spent pursuing it.
events.changes: The party receives a cup made from unicorn horn which purifies poisoned or undrinkable liquid. The girls depart the day after acceptance. On the final search day Riveria obtains the horn without killing the unicorn and sets off to return it to its herd.
events.knowledge: Amid explains its function to the recipients. Riveria says the high-elf village had a unicorn and she knows how to handle one; this is earlier experience, not a newly acquired taming ability.
events.uncertainty: Do not assume this item is carried on every later expedition, cures existing bodily poison, or proves universal poison immunity. The three-day limit and three search days are kept local; the prior paperwork day is not silently collapsed into a global three-day span. The completed return to the herd is not shown.

events.title: Freya arranges the grimoire’s indirect delivery
events.when: Before Bell acquires Firebolt; Runoa finds a book that was not there last night.
events.changes: The grimoire reaches Bell through the tavern.
events.knowledge: Freya’s concealed role is reader information, not Bell’s discovery.
events.uncertainty: The exact planting time is not established by Runoa’s discovery.

events.title: Aiz defeats Udaeus
events.when: Three days before the shared encounter with unconscious Bell.
events.changes: Udaeus defeated; Aiz needs recuperation during ascent.
events.uncertainty: Do not summarize as proof Riveria did nothing.

events.title: Firebolt appears in Bell’s Status
events.when: FM02, before his Mind Down encounter with Aiz.
events.changes: Bell gains Firebolt; remains Level One.
events.knowledge: Bell and Hestia know the new magic. Bell’s presented skill field remains blank.

events.title: Aiz and Riveria find Bell after Mind Down
events.when: Three days after Udaeus’s defeat.
events.changes: Bell is temporarily unconscious; Aiz attempts to make amends.
events.knowledge: Riveria identifies Mind Down. Aiz says she and Bell have not spoken directly.

events.title: Aiz’s Level Six becomes known in her Familia
events.when: SO03 opening after Udaeus and the shared Mind Down scene.
events.changes: Aiz now Level Six.
events.knowledge: Familia news spreads by the following morning.
events.uncertainty: Do not assign level acquisition to Udaeus’s death before the update.

events.title: Aiz retains Bell’s armguard and accepts the Floor 24 request
events.when: After helping Bell in Floor 10 fog; allies are to be met on Floor 18 before proceeding to 24.
events.changes: Aiz holds the green vambrace and undertakes the investigation.
events.knowledge: Bell does not clearly recognize his rescuer; the robed visitor’s identity is not universally disclosed.
events.uncertainty: No exact calendar date or exhaustive participant knowledge asserted.

events.title: Bell rescues Lilly and offers continuing help
events.when: FM02 climax, after learning Firebolt.
events.changes: Trust begins to replace Lilly’s exploitation of Bell; support relationship continues.
events.knowledge: Lilly hears Bell’s promise to help her.
events.uncertainty: This is not Lilly’s Falna conversion.

events.title: Bell cares for sick Hestia and meets Hephaistos through Miach
events.when: While Bell and Hestia still live beneath the church, after Lilly is his regular supporter and after the Hestia Knife was forged.
events.changes: Bell stays out of the Dungeon to care for Hestia. Lilly watches her while he seeks help. Miach introduces Bell to Hephaistos; Naaza guides his preparation of medicine. Hestia becomes energetic again but is still told to rest.
events.knowledge: Bell and Hephaistos exchange names and a handshake; Hephaistos already knows of him through Hestia. Miach explains the medicine is ordinary, emphasizing Bell’s care rather than a unique cure-all recipe.
events.uncertainty: This illness is distinct from the later Edas recovery. Renewed energy is not a measured complete recovery time or proof that this medicine treats every illness. A regular supporter arrangement alone does not prove placement after the specific rescue/reconciliation in TL-0010; that finer boundary is not asserted.
events.frame: SS01 Familia Panacea, one-day care episode with brief earlier-meeting recollections

events.title: Aria information reaches Loki and Finn but not the younger members
events.when: SO03 investigation and aftermath.
events.changes: Levis’s name for Aiz becomes a subject of investigation.
events.knowledge: Riveria relays Aiz’s report to Loki and Finn. Lefiya is denied an explanation; Tiona recognizes a literary name, not necessarily Aiz’s parentage.
events.uncertainty: Editorial identification cannot be imported into every character’s thoughts.

events.title: Bors tells Lefiya the Banshee story without knowing the full truth
events.when: SO03 Rivira visit, before the party reaches Olivas.
events.changes: Lefiya hears the informal Banshee nickname and accounts of destroyed parties; Bete stops to listen. Filvis is apart from them.
events.knowledge: Bors supplies reports and his observed return to Rivira, not the truth of Filvis’s transformation. His curse comparison is not a proved supernatural curse.
events.uncertainty: Banshee is explicitly not her official title. No comprehensive reliability is granted to every rumor.
events.frame: SO03 current conversation about older events

events.title: Tiona shares an anonymous market adventure with the helmeted boy
events.when: Day after Aiz’s Floor 24 expedition; Lefiya remains in bed with Mind Down while Aiz is being punished at home.
events.changes: Tiona sells old Familia belongings with the boy’s help; his cursed helmet prevents removal and changes how he perceives people. Naaza takes him away intending to treat it.
events.knowledge: Tiona calls herself Elna and never asks his name. He perceives her as an elf; neither learns the other’s real identity. Naaza identifies her customer by smell; Amid hears the curse problem.
events.uncertainty: No actual removal of the helmet is shown. Tiona’s roughly ninety-million debt is an attested balance, not the price or acquisition date of a newly obtained weapon. No exact global day or later recognition is inferred.
events.frame: SS02 My Memory, present market story after an explicitly labeled childhood dream

events.title: The Floor 24 party discovers Olivas alive in a transformed body
events.when: SO03 pantry confrontation, before Revis kills Olivas.
events.changes: The party sees Olivas’s regeneration and exposed stone. Filvis is shocked by survival Dionysus had concealed; her trust in him begins to fracture.
events.knowledge: Asfi explains the reported death and identity to Lefiya. Filvis’s reaction is genuine, but she does not disclose her own creature nature. Lefiya infers cooperation with the Evils.
events.uncertainty: Aiz is not retroactively made a listener to every earlier exchange; she joins the later confrontation. No public announcement or complete knowledge of the spirit’s identity.
events.frame: SO03 current revelation with SO12 confirmation of Filvis’s private response

events.title: Bete privately trains with Gareth after Aiz’s promotion
events.when: After Aiz reaches Level Six, during preparations for the next expedition.
events.changes: Gareth repeatedly bests Bete in a rented warehouse; Bete is bruised and wants the defeats kept from juniors.
events.knowledge: Finn knows Gareth is occupied with Bete; the private location does not prove nobody else knows the training occurs.
events.uncertainty: Not a claim Gareth wins every future duel or that Bete has already reached Level Six.
events.frame: SS02 A Man’s Pride, corroborated by A Clandestine Rendezvous

events.title: Revis kills Olivas and gains strength by consuming his stone
events.when: SO03 Floor 24 battle, after Aiz rejoins the other adventurers.
events.changes: Revis removes Olivas’s core; he turns to ash. She eats the stone and gains enough strength to pressure Level Six Aiz using her wind.
events.knowledge: The witnesses see the consumption and outcome. Aiz infers the enhanced-species mechanism but lacks their complete identities.
events.uncertainty: No new Falna level is assigned to Revis. The source spells her name Levis; evidence preserves it. Her prior human identity is not revealed.

events.title: Lefiya demonstrates Summon Burst and Riveria’s fire spell in training
events.when: During undated Floor 5 training; no acquisition day or exact main-story placement established.
events.changes: Lefiya repeatedly casts, unleashes Rea Laevateinn through Summon Burst and collapses into Mind Down. Riveria directs Aiz to carry her to Babel’s infirmary.
events.knowledge: Those present witness the magic and collapse; their speculation about wanting a piggyback ride is not a stated sole motive.
events.uncertainty: No permanent injury, completed treatment or guaranteed rate of Mind growth inferred. Display rank is navigational only.

events.title: Aiz trains Bell before Loki Familia’s next expedition
events.when: FM03 training interval; two more training days and departure in three days are stated locally.
events.changes: Bell receives combat instruction from Aiz.
events.knowledge: Hestia is told about the training and planned departure.

events.title: Aiz asks Amid for first-aid and lap-pillow instruction
events.when: Before Loki Familia’s upcoming expedition, while Aiz is concerned about potion use in training.

events.changes: Bell receives advice on the extraordinary achievement needed for growth.

events.uncertainty: Welf is still in Hephaistos Familia; party membership is not Falna membership.

events.title: Welf learns Lilly can disguise herself with magic

events.when: Later on the same Blue Twilight day as the rank-H notice and Lilly’s disguise.

events.frame: SS01 Blue Twilight, present visit and private conversation with brief recollections

events.title: Welf makes a weapon from Bell’s Minotaur horn
events.when: FM04, after their partnership and before the middle-floor journey.
events.changes: Bell obtains the horn-derived dagger.

events.title: Loki’s expedition is on its fourth day after witnessing Bell’s feat

events.title: Loki Familia defeats the Floor 59 demi-spirit
events.when: SO04 after witnessing Bell’s Minotaur victory; before the SO05 Floor 18 overlap.
events.changes: Expedition reaches Floor 59 and wins; prepares to leave.
events.uncertainty: No exact travel-day total derived from the displayed ordering.

events.title: Bell’s party learns about Naaza’s injury and Miach’s debt

events.knowledge: Bell and Lilly hear Naaza’s prosthesis history; Hestia responds to the financial problem.
events.uncertainty: No claim all listeners were previously ignorant of every fact.

events.title: Bete obtains scarce antivenin by pressuring Hermes Familia

events.changes: Bete secures Hermes Familia’s antivenin after Lulune initially refuses to act without her leaders.

events.uncertainty: The passage does not enumerate the concealed levels or prove this was Bete’s first discovery of them.

events.title: Bell’s party meets the returning Loki expedition on Floor 18
events.when: FM05 / SO05 shared safe-floor stay, after Floor 59.
events.changes: Bell’s party receives help and sightseeing guidance; planned return with Loki Familia.
events.uncertainty: This is one overlap, not separate trips to be added into cumulative elapsed time.

events.title: Riveria confirms Aiz’s spirit blood to the tent discussion
events.when: SO05 Floor 18 discussion.
events.changes: Spirit ancestry is partially confirmed.

events.uncertainty: This anchor alone does not enumerate all listeners; use surrounding tent scene for a particular speaker.

events.title: Riveria receives a tribute from the masked rescue adventurer
events.when: Night of Bell’s arrival on Floor 18.
events.changes: A water tribute and respectful note are left near Riveria’s bathing place.

events.uncertainty: Do not give Riveria a confirmed real identity from the reader’s contextual inference. The note is not formal allegiance or Familia conversion.

events.title: Lyu tells Bell about her blacklisting, losses, vengeance and rescue
events.when: During their Floor 18 graveyard conversation before the black Goliath battle.

events.knowledge: Bell learns her former alias, blacklisting, the trap and losses, vengeance, and Syr’s rescue. The account does not name the Juggernaut or disclose every private scene of the catastrophe.
events.uncertainty: Bell’s acceptance is not universal public exoneration, removal of the bounty or Lyu’s complete emotional recovery.
events.frame: FM05 contemporary disclosure at the graves

events.title: Welf chooses to use his magic sword to save his allies
events.when: FM05 black Goliath battle.
events.changes: Welf overcomes his refusal to use the magic sword in this crisis.
events.uncertainty: Do not backdate this development to his earlier refusal; later forging convictions develop further.

events.title: Aiz teaches Bell to hold onto hope in the deep floors
events.when: During earlier city-wall training, before the Floor 37 ordeal; exact session not identified.
events.changes: Aiz discusses hope and what she learned from Finn; Bell values seeing her smile.

events.uncertainty: Displayed with training for navigation only; it may belong to a later training session.
events.frame: SS01 Words of the Wind, earlier conversation recalled on Floor 37

events.title: The Floor 18 party returns; the Guild suppresses news but Apollo hears it

events.frame: FM05 epilogue, corroborated by FM06 retrospective

events.title: Lyu resumes her tavern shift and inadvertently discloses the bathing incident
events.when: Early morning on the day after the Floor 18 rescue party returned to the surface.
events.changes: Lyu is back at work; Bell visits the tavern.

events.uncertainty: Attendance is not proof Bell has fully recovered. This is the earlier Floor 18 rescue, not the later Floor 37 crisis.

events.title: Bell recovers after the Goliath and surface return
events.when: FM06 opening: three days after the Goliath battle; detailed retrospective puts surface return the following day and describes two days of recovery/contacting friends.
events.changes: Bell’s strength and mental energy recover with medicine.
events.uncertainty: The earlier three-day sentence could be read as dating both events together; it must not erase the explicit next-day return. Visits during recovery are not proof of full recovery.

events.title: Bete, Tiona and Tione reach Level Six

events.changes: Three additional Level Six adventurers; news becomes widespread.
events.uncertainty: Do not give their new levels to the Floor 59 battle itself.

events.title: Lefiya agrees to delay Four after qualifying on the expedition
events.when: SO06 post-expedition Status update, before Meren; actual Four occurs later in SO12.

events.knowledge: The choice is discussed between Lefiya and Loki. Eligibility is not already acquired Level Four power.
events.uncertainty: No exact date for reaching the target rank, new spell acquisition or claim every future update follows the same optimization rule.

events.title: Aiz and Lefiya learn the twins’ Telskyura background
events.when: SO06 contemporary encounter with Kali, before the Meren resolution.
events.changes: The younger listeners must reinterpret the twins’ past.
events.knowledge: Aiz newly learns about Telskyura; Lefiya knew of the country but is shocked by the sisters’ part in its rites.
events.uncertainty: This is not proof they hear every private scene shown to the reader.

events.title: Lefiya is held hostage during the Meren crisis
events.when: During the twins’ confrontation with Kali’s faction.
events.changes: Lefiya’s captivity constrains the party’s options.
events.uncertainty: No precise synchronization to every Apollo scene established.

events.title: Aki’s urgent message brings Finn and the remaining Familia to Meren
events.when: Three days after Loki and her initial group leave for Meren.
events.changes: Finn orders immediate mustering, collection of gear regardless of repair state and an emergency banner; he leaves with Fortia Spear.
events.knowledge: Aki brings Loki’s message about the twins. Mobilization does not mean every civilian learns the detailed crisis.
events.uncertainty: Source line 2040 names Tiona where the habitual pursuit description suggests Tione; preserve source wording rather than silently correcting the quote.

events.title: Meren conflict is over before the Apollo War Game
events.when: SO06 Meren excursion precedes FM06 War Game; SO07 recalls it afterward.
events.changes: Loki Familia returns from Meren and rests before the Apollo conflict culminates.
events.uncertainty: These anchors give arc ordering, not every SO06 confrontation’s exact date.

events.title: Meren’s aftermath is followed by Orario’s Apollo victory
events.when: Restaurant visit two days after the Telskyura business, before returning to Orario.
events.changes: The group remains in Meren during the local two-day interval. Kali and Bache are present; Kali invites Aiz to Telskyura but no acceptance or transfer is shown.

events.title: Loki recounts Aiz’s swimming ordeal after Meren
events.when: A few days after resolving the Meren affair.
events.changes: Aiz still cannot swim comfortably in this telling and reacts fearfully to another proposed lesson.

events.uncertainty: No clinical diagnosis, completed new lesson or subsequent swimming proficiency inferred.

events.title: Hestia accepts Apollo’s War Game after coercion

events.changes: The conflict moves toward a War Game.
events.uncertainty: Challenge, acceptance and recruitment are distinct stages.

events.uncertainty: Sharing sleeping space is not an agreed romantic relationship. No sustained injury or permanent sleep impairment inferred.
events.frame: SS01 The Dark Side of Training

events.title: Lilly, Mikoto and Welf convert to Hestia Familia
events.when: Before the Apollo War Game.
events.changes: Three Falna membership changes; Mikoto’s conversion blocks another transfer for at least a year.
events.uncertainty: An intention to return to a former Familia is not a completed return.

events.when: Five days before the Apollo War Game.
events.changes: Lilly replaces Luan during the infiltration.
events.knowledge: Lilly extracts Luan’s standing, relationships and forms of address to support impersonation. Hestia hears her explanation of the stink-pouch method; Naaza and Miach helped prepare it.
events.uncertainty: Conversion and infiltration are separate prerequisites; no global day assigned.

events.title: Pre-war equipment and training are completed
events.when: Apollo preparation; training scene two days before the War Game.
events.changes: Ushiwakamaru-Nishiki and improved Rabbit Armor completed; Welf’s magic swords named. Bell’s training ends before travel. Blacksmith is already acquired during forging. The prewar update shows Level Two, Strength SS1088, Defense SS1029, Dexterity SS1094, Agility SSS1302 and Magic A883.
events.knowledge: Hestia withholds the explanation of the extraordinary ranks from Bell; she infers renewed Aiz training rather than receiving his explicit report.

events.title: Bell departs two days before the Apollo War Game
events.when: Two days before the game; his teammates have already left for the destination.
events.changes: Bell’s departure is separate from the others; Hestia remains in Orario.
events.uncertainty: Do not move the entire Familia together on this departure.

events.title: Hestia Familia wins the Apollo War Game
events.when: After Bell’s training and the three conversions.
events.changes: Apollo must disband, surrender property and leave Orario; Hestia Familia obtains a new home.
events.knowledge: Public contest victory; no blanket disclosure of participants’ private histories.
events.uncertainty: Three-day game limit is not its actual duration.

events.title: Hestia Familia moves in, then attends the postwar ball
events.when: Move-in three days after Apollo War Game; ball four days after it.
events.changes: New home and household rules; subsequent ball. At the fourth-day ball Bell dances with Asfi, is briefly knocked unconscious during Mikoto’s mishap, fulfills Lilly’s request for a formal invitation, and finally dances with Hestia to an improvised band.
events.knowledge: Lilly, Welf and Mikoto hear the household rules while Bell is at the Guild. Their Falnas already bear Hestia’s mark; the subsequent paper contract is not conversion. Lilly tears up the hidden romance ban rather than assenting. Asfi tells Bell Hermes took her from a castle. Welf’s royalty identification is an inference from her bearing; his musical training does not establish professional violin mastery.

events.title: Lilly repays Soma and retrieves the Hestia Knife
events.when: Two days after the victory; Lilly is already converted.
events.changes: Lilly settles the debt and recovers Bell’s knife.
events.uncertainty: Repayment is not her conversion date.

events.title: Mikoto demonstrates Mikazuchi to Bell and Welf
events.when: After joining Hestia Familia, during training at their home.
events.changes: Mikoto executes the Full-Moon Throw on Bell with mats prepared.
events.knowledge: Bell and Welf learn the technique’s name and hear her account of Takemikazuchi’s teaching and Tsukuyomi’s objection.
events.uncertainty: Not a new Falna skill or acquisition on this afternoon. Bell’s embarrassment and impact do not establish a lasting injury.
events.frame: SS01 Mikazuchi, demonstration with retrospective explanation

events.title: Allen supplies Syr’s casino invitation and secretly watches the infiltration
events.when: Evening before the Grand Casino infiltration, with a narrator’s forward account of Allen’s later presence inside.
events.changes: Allen delivers the invitation and later infiltrates on Hedin’s investigation request while guarding Syr. He declines Syr’s invitation to see Anya.
events.knowledge: Bell and Lyu do not know Allen is present. The invitation to see Anya is not a completed reunion.
events.uncertainty: Do not place Allen’s later casino surveillance in the evening conversation or give Bell Syr’s identity from this privileged viewpoint.

events.title: Lyu and Syr rescue Anna from the Grand Casino
events.when: Between FM06 and FM07, explicitly specified in FC01’s official English afterword.
events.changes: Anna can return home; casino continues with a changed owner. Bell accepts occasional early-morning training.
events.knowledge: Anna’s exploitation is concealed from the public; Bell does not automatically learn Syr’s true identity.
events.uncertainty: Exact day within the interval is unknown. The afterword is authorial chronology evidence, not a character disclosure.

events.title: Anna tells her parents she loves her female rescuer
events.when: After Anna’s rescue from the casino and return home; exact interval unspecified.
events.changes: Anna confesses her feelings to her parents.
events.knowledge: Her parents learn the rescuer she loves is a woman. Lyu is absent and is not shown learning of this confession.
events.uncertainty: The title’s shiver does not demonstrate psychic knowledge; no reciprocated relationship established.
events.frame: SS02 And at that Moment, Lyu Leon Shivered

events.title: Lyu helps Bell find storybooks and asks to hear more
events.when: After the Apollo War Game, on an afternoon when Bell is not entering the Dungeon; exact later placement unestablished.
events.changes: They buy books together. Lyu asks Bell to tell her more stories, and he agrees.
events.knowledge: Lyu learns about Bell’s hobby; Bell hears that her family were village-protecting hunters. The supplier mistakes the outing for a date; Bell waits out of earshot and Lyu asks her not to tell Syr.
events.uncertainty: The old alias Little Rookie is not alone sufficient for a strict upper date bound. Lyu’s affection here is not a formal romantic confession or mutually established dating relationship; no claim Syr actually learns of it.
events.frame: SS01 A Bookshop Date?, present outing with childhood-reading discussion

events.title: Hestia’s knife debt disrupts recruitment
events.when: Postwar recruitment at the new home.
events.changes: The enormous debt becomes an obstacle to recruiting members.
events.knowledge: Public discovery of the debt does not reveal every property of the knife.
events.uncertainty: No exact calendar date or exhaustive participant knowledge asserted.

events.title: Bell’s Level Three is announced
events.when: After Apollo War Game; stated interval from previous level is one month.
events.changes: Bell now Level Three.
events.knowledge: Rank-up news becomes public.
events.uncertainty: Month is retained as a month, not converted into thirty days.

events.title: Eina’s Level Three guidelines for Bell are withheld from publication
events.when: After Bell’s Level Three becomes public.
events.changes: Eina completes an activity report; the Guild shelves it for a second time rather than publishing it.
events.knowledge: Eina and Misha discuss the report. Its contents are not thereby universal adventurer knowledge.
events.uncertainty: The report includes a within-ten-days phrase and a compressed list of feats. Preserve its text; do not silently extend that bound to every later surface event or turn one month into thirty days.
events.frame: SS01 The World’s Fastest Rabbit, Take Two

events.title: Lyu’s early-morning training promise is carried out
events.when: A few days after the casino affair.
events.changes: Bell trains with Lyu and is battered; Syr interrupts. The story explicitly identifies Bell as Level Three and Lyu as Level Four; it is after the promotion even though the casino precedes FM07.

events.title: Loki’s misleading gift advice causes a brief snowdrop misunderstanding
events.when: A few days after Apollo’s War Game and after Bell reaches Level Three; gift planning, next-day delivery and following-day clarification form a local sequence.
events.changes: Aiz brings flowers sincerely; the household interprets them as a threat. Bell tells her what happened the next day, and she confronts Loki.
events.knowledge: Aiz initially does not understand the flower implication; the household’s declaration-of-war interpretation is mistaken. In the overlapping SS02 doorstep scene, Aiz asks how Bell reached Level Three, not for a date. Tiona later confirms she missed the delivery.
events.uncertainty: Not an actual inter-Familia declaration of war. The gift is not proof of a romantic confession.

events.title: Haruhime tells Bell how she lost her home and reached the Pleasure Quarter
events.when: Their first extended private conversation in FM07, before Mikoto’s fuller childhood account.
events.changes: Haruhime shares her separation and sale history with Bell. He is shocked and privately questions the visiting aristocrat’s motives.
events.knowledge: Bell learns her noble origin and claimed cause of expulsion. His doubts are not spoken proof of innocence, and the conversation does not yet explain the Killing Stone.
events.uncertainty: Haruhime’s account contains uncertainty about the offering. Do not give Bell information from a later revelation merely because it concerns the same past.
events.frame: FM07 present conversation with historical testimony

events.title: Mikoto tells Bell and his companions about Haruhime, then adds the Falna history
events.when: First bookshop account, followed by an expanded account to Bell the next day.
events.changes: Mikoto confirms the childhood friendship and failed search; later she explains that helping Haruhime prompted the early blessings.
events.knowledge: Bell, Lilly and Welf hear the bookshop account. The later conversation explicitly refers to yesterday; its additional details are not automatically assigned to the earlier listeners.
events.uncertainty: The grouped record spans two conversations. Do not infer that Lilly and Welf hear the second merely because they heard the first.
events.frame: FM07 paired present disclosures of earlier history

events.title: Loki questions Filvis during an earlier Knossos entry
events.when: More than two months before the later first-assault framing in SS02.
events.changes: Filvis acts on her wish to protect Lefiya despite her god’s wishes.
events.knowledge: Filvis conceals Dionysus’s secrets through silence; Lefiya does not know how profoundly her words affected Filvis.
events.uncertainty: Loki’s suspicions do not establish completed knowledge of Enyo’s identity here.
events.frame: SS02 Memory of Days Lost, historical scene inside a later assault frame

events.title: Bell’s Daedalus Street encounter triggers mistaken accusations and later explanations
events.when: After Apollo’s War Game, during Bell’s first Pleasure Quarter trouble; night encounter, dawn search outcome and subsequent apology.
events.changes: The group abandons its investigation to look for Bell and Lefiya. Lefiya is found at dawn; Bell escapes and is reprimanded by Hestia, then later explains to Aiz and Lefiya.
events.knowledge: Tione conceals the second-entrance investigation behind a test-of-courage story. Tiona hears Bell’s account of abduction and persuades Aiz; Lefiya hears the correction before the potion accident reignites the dispute. Loki is not told the details when she asks.
events.uncertainty: No brothel sex is established. The physical potion spill is not proof it magically controls Lefiya. The final explanation does not explicitly certify complete reconciliation or disclosure to every earlier observer. The vial is called empty at 2848 and half-empty at 2872; preserve the inconsistency.
events.frame: SS02 Love Life on Labyrinth Lane, night and subsequent aftermath

events.title: Hermes tells Bell about the Killing Stone
events.when: Before the Ishtar retrieval quest and capture.
events.changes: Bell gains a lead on the threat to Haruhime.
events.knowledge: This explanation is limited; Bell has not yet been told all details of the sacrifice ritual.
events.uncertainty: No exact calendar date or exhaustive participant knowledge asserted.

events.title: Bell learns the Killing Stone’s threat to Haruhime
events.when: FM07 before the rescue attempt.
events.changes: Bell gains information needed for the rescue decision.
events.knowledge: Bell learns the ritual’s purpose and danger; his earlier awareness of a delivery was less complete.

events.title: Aisha reveals her failed intervention to Bell, Mikoto and Haruhime
events.when: After the Killing Stone explanation, before the final rescue.

events.knowledge: Bell and Mikoto hear the confession; Haruhime visibly reacts in surprise. Bell’s imagined picture of the punishment is his visualization, not an independently witnessed memory.
