events.frame: FM07 confession followed by a separate Berbera-room scene

events.title: Ishtar’s ambush injures companions and takes Bell
events.when: During the prepared Dungeon quest, before Haruhime’s rescue.
events.changes: Lilly and Welf are injured; Bell is captured.
events.uncertainty: No universal healed state follows from later escape.

events.title: Haruhime is freed; Ishtar is sent back to heaven
events.when: FM07 climax, the ritual night.
events.changes: Haruhime’s collar is broken and she is rescued; Ishtar’s earthly presence ends.
events.knowledge: Bell connects the silver-haired goddess with the gaze he has felt; no Syr identity revelation.
events.uncertainty: Rescue is not itself the conversion ritual; her later Hestia membership is separately attested.

events.when: First Knossos incursion, before escape from the trap.
events.changes: Finn is seriously injured; ordinary potions cannot heal the cursed wound and emergency freezing is used.

events.title: The trapped party defeats the bull at the cost of Urga
events.when: Later in the first Knossos incursion.

events.uncertainty: A replacement weapon is not automatically available at the battle’s end.

events.uncertainty: Casualty list is incomplete; do not use these anchors as a full named roster.
events.frame: SO08 recalled Knossos death; SS02 supplies Leene’s dying perspective and a separate earlier memory.

events.when: During Bete’s search for Knossos information after leaving the Familia; after a Dungeon outing with Lena.

events.knowledge: Bell sees the feeding scene. Separately, Elfie’s report reaches Lefiya and Aiz; Aiz initially disbelieves it.

events.title: Hestia formally welcomes Haruhime after her rescue
events.when: Next-day aftermath of Ishtar’s fall; later FM08 confirms Conversion.
events.changes: Haruhime requests membership and is welcomed.
events.knowledge: She exchanges names with Welf and Lilly; their earlier aid is not prior acquaintance.
events.uncertainty: The welcome is shown; exact timing of the separate Falna ritual remains unstated.

events.title: Bete uses Hati; Lena’s survival is disclosed later
events.when: SO08 retaliation and aftermath.
events.changes: Hati is used in battle but does not heal his wounds; Lena survives treatment.
events.knowledge: Riveria withheld Lena’s uncertain survival during the crisis; Bete learns later.
events.uncertainty: Do not interpret battle fury as proof Lena died, or Hati’s absorption as automatic healing.

events.title: Aiz hears thanks for Monsterphilia and joins Hermes Familia’s remembrance
events.when: On an undated outing after Leene’s death and Lena’s survival; Monsterphilia is described as over two months earlier.
events.changes: Repaired streets and Rivira are observed. Bors says work on Udaeus’s sword is unfinished. Aiz agrees to remember Hermes Familia’s dead and continue exploring.
events.knowledge: Aiz hears survivors’ way of mourning. Bors’s evasive response does not reveal the actual fate of the entrusted material.
events.uncertainty: Over two months is not an exact duration. No new permanent smithing contract or finished Udaeus weapon for Aiz is established.
events.frame: SS02 Paths So Far, an Unending Journey, current outing with earlier battles recalled

events.title: Ottar asks Aiz about Udaeus’s sword on Floor 9
events.when: During Aiz’s return from the Floor 18 outing in Paths So Far.
events.changes: Ottar questions Aiz and continues deeper; Tsubaki is testing a new naginata and gathering materials.
events.knowledge: Aiz suggests solo combat may explain the sword. Her suggestion is not proof of an exclusive spawning rule.
events.uncertainty: Do not force FC02’s three-month anchor onto every scene of this outing or infer Ottar commissioned a weapon from Tsubaki; he does not accept her solicitation.
events.frame: SS02 Paths So Far, current Floor 9 encounter

events.title: Aiz thanks Bell at the site of his Minotaur fight
events.when: After the Ottar encounter during the same Dungeon return.
events.changes: Bell is making a solo Dungeon visit on a scheduled day off; Aiz thanks him and returns to the surface while he proceeds onward.
events.knowledge: Bell hears that he saved them but remains baffled; Aiz does not explain how his example inspired the corrupted-spirit victory.
events.uncertainty: Do not give Bell the full Loki expedition story from Aiz’s internal explanation. Thanks are not an explicit mutual romantic confession.
events.frame: SS02 Paths So Far, current meeting recalling the Minotaur and expedition

events.title: Aiz sees Rubart’s new work and hears Kali’s post-Ishtar account
events.when: Later that afternoon; Meren hostility is recalled as about a month earlier and Ishtar has already fallen.
events.changes: Rubart now works with the fishermen after dismissal. Argana pursues Finn, Bache pursues Argana, and Kali tours Orario in disguise.
events.knowledge: Aiz recognizes Kali only after the mask is shown. Kali says they had waited in Meren for Ishtar and disclaims knowledge of the Evils. The disclaimer is her claim, not an exhaustive innocence finding.
events.uncertainty: No completed Aiz conversion or Finn relationship. The watch’s fifth-time-this-week statement concerns repeated incursions, not five independently dated battles. Source line 4412 names Rod amid a description apparently of Rubart; do not silently repair a quotation.
events.frame: SS02 Paths So Far, present encounters and reported recent history

events.title: Aiz and Filvis first speak alone before Aiz visits the fallen
events.when: At dusk after the marketplace encounters, before Filvis’s final death.
events.changes: Filvis poses a question about failing to save others. Aiz leaves flowers for seven fallen companions, including Leene; Lena thanks her and the Familia later joins her.
events.knowledge: Aiz has heard Filvis’s apparent survivor story from Lefiya, not the later Ein revelation. Filvis directs the arriving companions to Aiz’s location. Aiz’s seeming conversation with Leene is not independently confirmed communication with the dead.
events.uncertainty: Lena wanting to ask Bete about children establishes neither agreement nor a family. Aiz’s resolve here does not erase grief or establish universal later confidence.
events.frame: SS02 Paths So Far, current graveside conversations with recalled losses

events.title: Haruhime’s conversion and support role are established
events.when: By the FM08 Floor 18 visit; conversion was recent, exact ceremony date unstated here.
events.changes: Haruhime is now converted and travels with the party.
events.knowledge: Her Level Boost and presence are deliberately kept secret.

events.title: Laurier discovers captive Xenos at an Elurian noble’s mansion
events.when: A little over two months before Laurier’s pre-festival encounter with Bell.
events.changes: Laurier’s overseas intelligence work uncovers captive Xenos.
events.knowledge: The retrospective narrator identifies her discovery; this passage does not identify every person subsequently told or a disclosure date.
events.uncertainty: No rescue or exact discovery day established here. Display rank is navigational; no exact relation to neighboring main-story arcs asserted.
events.frame: SS01 Is it Wrong to Fake an Accident…, retrospective background during Laurier’s crisis

events.title: Takemikazuchi gives Mikoto Chizan and keeps Tenka for her return
events.when: FM08 gift exchange before the next day’s training.
events.changes: Mikoto receives one dagger; the other is reserved for her future return.
events.knowledge: Observers’ proposal comparison is their interpretation, not an established engagement.
events.uncertainty: No exact calendar date or exhaustive participant knowledge asserted.

events.title: Hestia reveals Bell’s growth skill to four Familia members while Bell is absent
events.when: FM08 household evening after Haruhime’s rescue and recruitment; before Lilly’s sleepless night and following morning.
events.changes: Lilly and Haruhime are shaken by learning the connection between Bell’s feelings for Aiz and his growth. Lilly subsequently spends a sleepless night.
events.knowledge: Hestia discloses Liaris Freese and its connection to Bell’s feelings to Lilly, Welf, Mikoto and Haruhime, demands secrecy, and explicitly says Bell has not been told. Bell has left the room; he is not a recipient.
events.uncertainty: No knowledge is assigned to Aiz, Loki Familia or outsiders. Hestia’s comment about Bell’s inability to keep secrets is her stated rationale, not a universal personality rule.

events.title: Finn proposes and Lilly chooses to remain with her Familia
events.when: FM08 proposal and later refusal, before the new gear delivery.
events.changes: Finn offers a partnership for his prum aspiration; Lilly declines.
events.knowledge: Bell and others’ responses must be confined to their actual conversations.
events.uncertainty: No marriage, completed Finn relationship or conversion results.

events.title: Loki Familia’s Rakian fighting overlaps FM08
events.when: SO09 contemporary framing during the Rakian invasion.
events.changes: Lefiya’s battlefield reputation grows.
events.knowledge: SO10 recalls Loki’s Hermes commission during the Rakian skirmish three weeks earlier.
events.uncertainty: The three weeks anchor the referenced commission, not every FM08 vignette.

events.title: Welf delivers Kotetsu and the Goliath robes
events.when: Evening before the mini-expedition preparations.
events.changes: Mikoto receives Kotetsu; Lilly and Haruhime receive heavy black-hide robes. The robes do not cushion impacts.
events.uncertainty: The boast about blades and spells is not proof of unconditional invulnerability.

events.title: Lena guides the search on the fifth night of Rakia’s attack
events.when: Fifth night after the Rakian attack begins.
events.changes: Lena alive and present as a Knossos lead.
events.knowledge: Lena privately thanks Bete for flowers and says she loves him; he does not reciprocate verbally in this passage.

events.title: Welf rejects Rakia’s demand and restates his ambition
events.when: FM08 confrontation with his father and grandfather.
events.changes: Welf chooses his own smithing path; Rakian conspirators are captured.

events.title: Welf makes a conditional confession to Hephaistos
events.when: Daybreak after confronting his father and grandfather.
events.changes: Welf asks for a romantic reward if he forges a weapon that satisfies her.
events.knowledge: Hephaistos hears the confession directly.
events.uncertainty: The condition is not already fulfilled; no marriage is established.

events.title: Bell escorts Eina during the apparent stalking incident
events.when: FM08 receptionist episode, before the village retreat.
events.changes: Bell provides an escort; competing suitors and divine interference explain parts of the incident.
events.knowledge: Eina’s fear precedes the explanations; her accusation of Bell’s confession is not proof he meant one.
events.uncertainty: No exact calendar date or exhaustive participant knowledge asserted.

events.title: Hestia recuperates at Edas Village
events.when: Three days of illness/rest after the mountain flight.
events.changes: Bell stays near Hestia; Aiz guards or patrols the house. Their availability in Orario is limited.

events.title: Aiz returns from Edas and her explanation is misunderstood
events.when: On returning from Edas; Lefiya describes the absence as five days.
events.changes: Aiz reunites with the household and describes having pushed Bell onto a bed; listeners misunderstand the circumstances.
events.knowledge: Lefiya initially does not know about Edas Village. Riveria infers an innocent explanation; neither is evidence that Bell and Aiz had a sexual encounter.
events.uncertainty: Do not replace the separately attested three-day illness/rest interval with this broader count.

events.title: Lefiya meets Haruhime and hears that she joined Bell’s Familia
events.when: After Haruhime joins Hestia Familia, while Loki Familia searches for Knossos clues.
events.changes: Lefiya encounters Haruhime for the first time described here.
events.knowledge: Bell introduces her as a recent Familia recruit and denies dating Aiz. Lefiya’s accusation does not establish a romantic relationship or infidelity.
events.uncertainty: No disclosure of Haruhime’s magic, past or rescue details occurs in these lines.

events.title: Bell and Aiz investigate a haunted mansion without recognizing Fels
events.when: After leaving the old church; probably during Bell’s Level Three period, from his three-level gap below Level Six Aiz. Exact arc/day unknown.
events.changes: Aiz asks Bell for confidential help; they flee Fels’s workshop. Fels intends to relocate; next day the client reports no more ghost sightings.
events.knowledge: Bell learns Aiz fears ghosts. Neither identifies Fels in the scene. Fels tells Ouranos who discovered the workshop but does not understand their reason; Ouranos has the failed-quest report.
events.uncertainty: The failed quest was a private favor, not a formal Guild commission. Do not give Bell or Aiz Fels’s identity from the reader’s explanatory coda. Aiz’s painful grip is not a diagnosed lasting injury.
events.frame: SS01 Ghostbuster Aiz and Her Rabbit Companion, Bell viewpoint followed by Fels/Ouranos coda

events.title: Hephaistos tells Hestia about Welf; gossip later spreads among gods
events.when: After Hephaistos helps against Rakia; gossip spreads in the days following the drinking conversation.
events.changes: Hephaistos recounts Welf’s words to Hestia; Hestia subsequently spreads an account that will underpin a later alias.
events.knowledge: This is a disclosure channel to other gods, not the alias-conferral scene. Hephaistos challenges Hestia’s added claim that Bell said he loved her.
events.uncertainty: Do not certify Hestia’s embellished quotation as Bell’s exact words or backdate the later alias to this night.
events.frame: SS01 Where It All Began, drinking scene plus later gossip summary

events.title: A threatening admirer makes Lilly deny any interest in Finn
events.when: After Finn’s proposal; Lilly thinks the tailing began a few days afterward.
events.changes: A long-haired woman corners Lilly, demands her feelings about Finn and leaves after Lilly professes devotion to Bell.
events.knowledge: The pursuer hears Lilly’s denial; Bell later sees her distressed but is not shown hearing the interrogation.
events.uncertainty: No exact date for the proposal is established by this story and no permanent psychological diagnosis follows from its comic description.

events.title: Aiz privately imagines dancing with Bell after Edas
events.when: A few days after Rakia’s surrender and after the Edas visit.
events.changes: Aiz enjoys the remembered festival and unconsciously imagines Bell as her dance partner while practicing alone.
events.knowledge: The three observers notice her smile but explicitly do not know its cause. Bell does not receive a confession or share this imagined dance.
events.uncertainty: No exact offset from the Wiene encounter or confirmed romantic self-understanding is supplied.
events.frame: SS01 A Happy Beat, contemporary practice recalling Edas

events.title: Bell’s party reaches the safe point after the Rakian war
events.when: Three days after the war ends; opening of FM09.
events.changes: Party has independently reached the safe point and accepts a quest.

events.title: Ottar’s fellow elites interrupt his Udaeus journey until Hedin stops them
events.when: During the Udaeus expedition, at the bottom of the Great Falls; roughly half a day of travel to his target remains afterward.
events.changes: Six elites attack Ottar; Hedin intervenes carrying Freya’s written instruction, gives him an elixir, and the expedition resumes.
events.knowledge: The challengers receive Freya’s instruction through Hedin. Other adventurers misinterpret the disturbance as a possible monster incident.
events.uncertainty: The half-day is local travel, not the whole expedition duration. Hegni and Hedin use established magic; this is not its acquisition date. Allen’s prepared ultimate attack is interrupted.
events.frame: FC02 contemporary journey interrupted by historical memories

events.title: Wiene is sheltered by Hestia Familia
events.when: FM09, after Bell’s rescue; the next morning her leg has healed.
events.changes: Wiene lives in secret in the manor; trust with Haruhime grows gradually.
events.knowledge: Household knows of her; this is not public acceptance of intelligent monsters.

events.title: Ottar challenges Udaeus three months after Aiz’s feat
events.when: Exactly three months after Aiz defeats Udaeus; a separate earlier sentence describes news of her feat three months ago.
events.changes: Ottar is Level Seven; his weapon breaks in the fight. Udaeus’s strike destroys breastplate and shoulder armor, burns and lacerates Ottar, damages bones and cracks his Goibniu greatsword. Hildis Vini is used; the weapon then shatters. The elites see him wounded after the victory; the Guild receives a report.
events.knowledge: Freya sees through his stated rare-drop motive.
events.uncertainty: Display near Xenos is navigational only; precise alignment with FM arcs remains unplaced. FC02 5442 provides a direct battle-to-battle month anchor, strengthening the earlier news-based reading. No ninety-day conversion, precise FM arc alignment, or magic-acquisition date follows.

events.title: Aisha hears Lyu’s stated romantic ideal after a shared Dungeon errand
events.when: Night after Lyu and Aisha help Bell in the Dungeon; after Haruhime’s rescue, with exact day unassigned.
events.changes: Lyu returns in time for the night shift and is reprimanded for failing to notify Mia. Aisha visits and teases her.
events.knowledge: Aisha says she will not expose Lyu’s identity and hears her stated ideal of an eternal-love vow before intimacy.
events.uncertainty: No actual vow, kiss or sexual encounter is shown. The ideal is Lyu’s stated view here, not a universal rule for all elves.

events.title: Ottar receives the custom Supreme Black Sword after Udaeus
events.when: Some time after the Udaeus victory; after Goibniu Familia completes the commissioned weapon.
events.changes: Ottar collects a first-tier weapon made from Udaeus’s drop and presents it to Freya; she names it Supreme Black Sword.
events.knowledge: Freya hears his assessment of the journey and supplies the name.
events.uncertainty: No crafting duration or complete physical recovery date given. Do not backdate possession to the Udaeus encounter.

events.title: Mikoto tells Haruhime Bell was prepared to leave Orario with her
events.when: Observation-journal Day 3, morning, during Wiene’s initial household stay.
events.changes: Haruhime learns of Bell’s earlier willingness to flee the city for her safety.
events.knowledge: Wiene and Fels hear the conversation; Bell is otherwise engaged. Fels’s deductions about the Pleasure Quarter remain his own interpretation.
events.uncertainty: Fels’s planned shorter report does not transfer this detailed exchange to Ouranos.
events.frame: SS01 Observations of a Mage, recorded present disclosure about an earlier decision

events.title: Wiene rests with Hestia three days after entering her care
events.when: Three days after taking Wiene into their care.
events.changes: Wiene has become attached to her protectors.
events.knowledge: Hestia has told Hephaistos about the situation earlier that day. This does not prove disclosure of the later Xenos organization or every unrelated Familia secret.
events.uncertainty: The same lap/parents scene appears under diary Day 4, compatible with three elapsed days. But one story calls it midafternoon while the diary labels it Morning; preserve the time-of-day discrepancy instead of forcing an hour.

events.title: Fels observes Wiene’s household but withholds the personal diary
events.when: Observation journal Days 1–4 during Wiene’s initial stay, before the Guild-directed village visit.
events.changes: Ouranos orders surveillance; Gafiel helps Fels observe the household. Fels’s response shifts between hope and doubt.
events.knowledge: Fels expressly rejects handing Ouranos the personal diary and intends a narrower report. Do not give Ouranos every observation or conjecture in the story.
events.uncertainty: Fels’s interpretation of motives is fallible, explicitly called projection and conjecture; the final narrower report is intended, not shown being delivered.
events.frame: SS01 Observations of a Mage, private journal and writing frame

events.title: Bell reassures Wiene beneath a shooting star
events.when: Night of observation-journal Day 4, while Wiene stays at Hearthstone Manor.
events.changes: Wiene wishes to stay together forever; Bell reassures her.
events.knowledge: Fels observes and privately doubts the reassurance’s conviction. This is his assessment, not evidence Bell knows the future.
events.uncertainty: No proof the promise will literally be fulfilled or that Wiene knows Fels is watching.
events.frame: SS01 Observations of a Mage, an observed interaction within Fels’s journal

events.title: Hestia Familia meets Lido and the intelligent-monster group
events.when: FM09 hidden-village encounter.
events.changes: Party discovers a community beyond Wiene. After the initial separation, Fia uses Aruru to comfort Wiene in the village; her later respect for Aruru’s boundaries is a future aside, not immediate adjustment.
events.knowledge: Named party learns the monsters tested their willingness to protect Wiene.

events.title: Mikoto receives her old Familia’s reassurance without revealing the Xenos
events.when: Day after Hestia Familia returns from leaving the Xenos child.
events.changes: Mikoto visits her former home; Chigusa and Ouka promise to find her if she is ever driven away, and she stays for lunch.
events.knowledge: Mikoto withholds the real reason for her worry. Their reassurance does not establish knowledge of Wiene or the Xenos.
events.uncertainty: Not a Falna reconversion or a literal occurrence of Mikoto’s hypothetical banishment.
events.frame: SS01 The Form of a Family

events.title: Haruhime mourns Wiene’s absence while the household misreads her distress
events.when: Day after parting with the Xenos and returning to the surface.
events.changes: Haruhime cries in Bell’s room, missing Wiene. Others keep Bell from entering because they misunderstand her behavior.
events.knowledge: The narrator identifies grief; the watching household’s sexual interpretation is explicitly wrong.
events.uncertainty: No sexual encounter occurs and no literal parenthood is established by Haruhime’s family comparison.

events.title: Hestia tells Lilly and Welf about her Ouranos conversation
events.when: Day after Bell returns from the Guild’s Xenos-village mission.
events.changes: Familia leadership assesses the secret.
events.knowledge: Hestia reports her conversation with Ouranos specifically to Lilly and Welf.

events.title: Fels resurrects Wiene
events.when: FM10 climax after her death.
events.changes: Wiene restored to life; Fels exhausted.
events.knowledge: Bell witnesses the resurrection; Fels calls it the first success in eight hundred years.
events.uncertainty: Does not establish dependable repeatable resurrection or an exact Fels birthday.

events.title: Bell tells Lilly his choice to help the Xenos despite public hostility
events.when: On the nighttime trip to the Witch’s Hideaway in response to Fels’s secret message, before the escape operation.
events.changes: Bell acknowledges the strain of losing public trust but prioritizes the Xenos and thanks his Familia for sharing the burden.
events.knowledge: Lilly hears his reasoning directly; their shopping pretense does not publicly reveal the mission.
events.uncertainty: Not indifference to public hostility or a promise that his reputation will recover.
events.frame: SS01 Lilly’s Special Place, Beside You

events.title: Hestia updates Bell before the Xenos escape; he remains Level Three
events.when: Evening of the Xenos rescue operation, before heading to Daedalus Street.

events.knowledge: Hestia and Bell see the current update; Hestia does not yet know how much he will grow that night.
events.uncertainty: Last-update/week-ago wording and the retrospective list of trials are preserved in the excerpt, not expanded into an exact global calendar.

events.title: Mord and his allies let Bell escape a Daedalus Street confrontation
events.when: Night of the Xenos rescue operation, shortly after Bell enters Daedalus Street.
events.changes: Mord and roughly half the threatening crowd side with Bell, allowing him to continue his diversion.
events.knowledge: Mord says he will not ask questions and frames help as a claim on a reward. This does not show him learning the Xenos plan or accepting intelligent monsters.
events.uncertainty: Bell notices the help, but the text does not establish a completed reward payment.

events.title: The hidden Xenos receive an oculus view of Bell’s surface encounters
events.when: Escape-operation night, before Welf and Mikoto reach the hidden Xenos.
events.changes: The hidden group watches Bell’s encounters through its oculus.
events.knowledge: They see the named women appearing around Bell. Possible paired-crystal interference is a suggested mechanism, not a confirmed universal oculus capability. Wiene’s sleeping account is innocently meant and misconstrued.
events.uncertainty: No blanket access to every command-room conversation, romantic relationship or private human thought.
events.frame: SS01 Monstrous Longing, and a Sage’s Enlightenment

events.title: Riveria’s group hears Fels explain the Xenos
events.when: SO10 underground sequence during FM11 escape operation.
events.changes: The confrontation becomes an explicit argument over coexistence.
events.knowledge: Fels names the Xenos and Ouranos’s wish to these listeners.

events.title: Finn makes a limited alliance with the Xenos
events.when: SO10 after the three-sided Knossos battle.
events.changes: Conditional cooperation for the coming Knossos assault; injured Rei healed.
events.knowledge: Those present hear the agreement and its limits.
events.uncertainty: Not permanent universal reconciliation or abolition of anti-monster beliefs.

events.title: Wiene’s self-injury challenges Aiz’s view of monsters
events.when: FM11 / SO10 confrontation before Bell’s Asterios rematch.
events.changes: Wiene tears away claws and wings; Aiz’s categorical rejection is shaken.
events.knowledge: Aiz directly witnesses an act she thought impossible for a monster.
events.uncertainty: This does not erase all her hatred, disclose all her history to Bell, or establish blanket acceptance of monsters.

events.title: Asterios defeats Bell and promises another match
events.when: FM11 final battle, after the escape operation.
events.changes: Bell loses, but gains a personal rival and renewed reason to grow.
events.knowledge: Their future rematch is a promise, not an event already fulfilled.
events.uncertainty: Bell’s public reputation and Xenos friendship are different issues.

events.title: Lefiya witnesses Bell’s tears after Asterios and renews her rivalry
events.when: After Finn’s Fels/Xenos negotiation and after Bell’s defeat by Asterios, during the immediate Babel aftermath.
events.changes: Lefiya leaves the returning group, reaches Babel and sees Bell crying; she privately resolves to keep pace with him.
events.knowledge: She observes the aftermath, not the entire fight. Her confidence that he will grow is expectation, not future knowledge.
events.uncertainty: Do not assign the unnamed stretcher patient’s severe spine injury to Bell. Her self-declared rivalry does not demonstrate Bell’s agreement.
events.frame: SS02 And So the Girl Sets Off Running Once More

events.title: Xenos return safely; Fels restores Asterios’s arm
events.when: FM11 aftermath.
events.changes: Surviving Xenos return; Asterios’s preserved severed arm is restored.
events.uncertainty: Do not carry his one-armed battle condition indefinitely beyond this healing.

events.title: Finn announces the Xenos cooperation while withholding Ouranos
events.when: After the Xenos conflict; before the renewed Knossos operation.
events.changes: The Familia is told of cooperation with intelligent monsters.
events.knowledge: Finn withholds Ouranos’s involvement; the announcement does not give every member the full secret.
events.uncertainty: No exact calendar date or exhaustive participant knowledge asserted.

events.title: Bell reaches Level Four
events.when: FM12 opening; Hestia describes two months since Level Three.
events.changes: Level Four; new escape-related development ability shown.
events.knowledge: Hestia discusses the level-up with Bell.
events.uncertainty: No month-to-day conversion.

events.title: Hestia explains Ox Slayer to the household
events.when: Day Bell reaches Level Four.
events.changes: Ox Slayer is available in the updated Status.
events.knowledge: Hestia briefs the other members while Bell is absent; this scene alone does not prove when Bell learns the explanation. Haruhime names Liaris Freese alongside Ox Slayer; the household discusses the absence of a Hestia-related skill. This attests household knowledge by this meeting, not the original date each learned it. The earlier disclosure of Liaris Freese to Lilly, Welf, Mikoto and Haruhime is now directly located in FM08, TL-0247; the anthology reference does not originate that knowledge.

events.title: Hermes arranges the expedition as a diversion from Knossos
events.when: Before Bell’s party departs for its official mission.
events.changes: The mission’s scheduling keeps Bell’s household away from the operation.
events.knowledge: Hermes initiates the arrangement; Ouranos and Fels accept it. The household does not know that motive.
events.uncertainty: No exact calendar date or exhaustive participant knowledge asserted.

events.title: Eina’s dinner invitation becomes a group tavern outing
events.when: Before Hestia Familia’s planned lower-floor expedition, after a Guild class.
events.changes: Bell accepts dinner and invites his friends to the Benevolent Mistress, frustrating Eina’s hope of something approaching a date.
events.knowledge: Bell interprets her request as a need for company; Lilly and Syr tease her about her intentions.
events.uncertainty: Eina’s private romantic intent does not establish a mutual date or that Bell understands her feelings.

events.title: Haruhime receives a grimoire and practices the new magic
events.when: Before the Floor 25 crisis; reading and practice precede demonstration.
events.changes: The grimoire acquired through Aisha enables the new magic’s preparation.
events.knowledge: The practice and acquisition precede its public use; do not grant the power during the later demonstration.
events.uncertainty: The acquisition’s exact cumulative date remains unknown.

events.title: Adventurers witness Bell fighting iguaçu but miss his mermaid encounter
events.when: During Bell’s initial Floor 25 separation from his expedition party.
events.changes: The observing party turns back; stories of Bell’s solo fight later spread.
events.knowledge: Observers recognize Bell and witness the fight, but explicitly miss the events involving the mermaid and enhanced species.
events.uncertainty: The report does not make Mari or Xenos secrets public; no precise time for the later spread of gossip is supplied.
events.frame: SS01 What the Adventurers Saw, observer scene with subsequent-rumor aside

events.title: Haruhime demonstrates the group Level Boost
events.when: FM12 Moss Huge crisis.
events.changes: Kokonoe combines with Uchide no Kozuchi for multiple targets.
events.knowledge: The party sees the new trump card in action.

events.title: Mari tells the returning Xenos she has met Bell
events.when: After Mari meets Bell, when Xenos returning from Fels’s request visit the Floor 27 village.
events.changes: Mari is stationed as lookout at the hidden Floor 27 village; she tells Rei and the gathered girls about Bell.
events.knowledge: Her eating-a-part-of-me remark causes misunderstanding. Lido and Gros keep Wiene from hearing the conversation.
events.uncertainty: This is not proof of sexual contact or reciprocal romance. Exact placement relative to the expedition’s other crises remains unestablished; rank is for navigation.
events.frame: SS01 The Bride of the Water Capital has a Fondness for White Rabbits

events.title: Parasitic ivy prevents ordinary treatment of Chigusa and Luvis
events.when: Moss Huge crisis before the final counterattack.
events.changes: Healing attempts feed the ivy; both remain impaired.
events.uncertainty: Neither ordinary potion use nor the encounter’s end alone proves full recovery.

events.title: Bell uses Argo Vesta against the enhanced monster
events.when: FM12 climax.
events.changes: Bell demonstrates the combined knife/flame/charge attack Argo Vesta.

events.title: Cassandra’s warnings fail to stop the search party’s descent
events.when: During the search for Lyu after departing Rivira, before the party reaches Floor 24.
events.changes: Cassandra approaches companions with warnings but the party continues. Her attempt to enlist Haruhime’s help is derailed.

events.frame: SS01 Plight of the Prophet, current descent with an uncertain dream/anecdote inside it

events.title: Bell believes Lyu rather than the murder accusation
events.when: FM13 investigation, before the Juggernaut disaster.
events.changes: Bell maintains trust in Lyu while she pursues Jura.
events.knowledge: Bell’s belief and Lyu’s accusation of Jura are distinct from an omniscient finding of innocence.

events.title: Bell and Lyu are carried to Floor 37
events.when: FM13 ending after the Juggernaut encounter.
events.changes: Both isolated on Floor 37, separated from the expedition.
events.knowledge: Bell recognizes the floor from Eina’s instruction.

events.title: Barca transforms and dies when Amid dispels the curse
events.when: During the concurrent Knossos operation.
events.changes: Barca becomes a parasitized monster and dies under purification.
events.knowledge: Finn stops before striking because the target is already dead.
events.uncertainty: Do not assign a finishing kill to Finn.

events.title: Knossos fighting overlaps the Floor 37 rescue crisis
events.when: FM14 prologue while Fels is accompanying the Xenos at Knossos.
events.changes: Loki forces are occupied; Ouranos orders reinforcements for the Water Capital.
events.knowledge: Ouranos senses an irregularity and approximate movement, not every detail of Bell’s predicament.
events.uncertainty: Exact SO chapter/day equivalence is not fixed by this passage alone.

events.title: Lyu teaches Bell an emergency source of fluid before the hidden spring
events.when: During the Floor 37 ordeal, after scavenging the dead adventurers’ supplies and before finding the spring.
events.changes: Lyu collects blue ooze fluid; Bell uses a very weak Firebolt to light the fire; both drink the boiled fluid. Bell continues carrying Lyu.
events.knowledge: Bell learns the method and hears that Lyu learned it from a book lent by a former companion. Lyu’s embarrassment over the shared flask is concealed from him.
events.uncertainty: No new magic acquisition: this is controlled use of existing Firebolt. Do not generalize drinkability to every ooze color or treat the unnamed former companion’s experiment as occurring now.
events.frame: SS01 Deep-Floor Survival, crisis scene containing Lyu’s brief recollection

events.title: Welf forges Shikou Kazuki in the Dungeon
events.when: FM14 parallel rescue-party route, during Bell and Lyu’s four-day ordeal.
events.changes: Reusable Welf magic sword reduces the battered party’s combat burden.
events.knowledge: Party sees its use; this is not public knowledge of its design.
events.uncertainty: Display order does not place forging on a particular one of the four days.

events.title: Bell recalls Aiz’s advice while surviving Floor 37 with Lyu
events.when: After the third short rest during the Floor 37 ordeal.
events.changes: Bell draws resolve from hopes of returning home and bringing Lyu back.
events.knowledge: Lyu hears his immediate response but is not shown receiving the full private memory of Aiz’s words.
events.uncertainty: Five-minute sleep is local, not an elapsed-day anchor.
events.frame: SS01 Words of the Wind, contemporary Floor 37 frame

events.title: Lyu fights the Juggernaut with luminous-wind orbs
events.when: FM14 final Floor 37 battle.
events.changes: Lyu presses the final attack despite injuries.
events.knowledge: Her vision of her ten companions is explicitly a hallucination; Bell sees her flight, not resurrected allies.
events.uncertainty: This is not her later Astrea Record magic.

events.title: Bell and Lyu are rescued after four days below
events.when: Four days after the wormwell carried them to Floor 37; later three days asleep.
events.changes: Rescued and hospitalized; Lyu on strict bed rest; Bell’s arm still requires care.
events.knowledge: Rescuers receive a floor-level lead through Ouranos/Fels, then locate them by battle sounds; not omniscient tracking.

events.title: Filvis privately renews her vow before the first major assault
events.when: At the first-assault muster, before SO11’s aftermath; more than two months after TL-0150.
events.changes: Filvis resolves to protect Lefiya while entering Knossos.
events.knowledge: The vow is explicitly unheard; do not treat it as a promise spoken to Lefiya.
events.uncertainty: The term first assault does not mean first encounter with Knossos.
events.frame: SS02 Memory of Days Lost, contemporary framing

events.title: Knossos assault ends in apparent loss and blocked exits
events.when: SO11 after Bell’s Level Four announcement; before SO12 counterattack.
events.changes: Thanatos’s return leaves a shaft; monstrous flesh fills openings and the crisis continues.
events.knowledge: Dionysus’s apparent return is the contemporary account, later corrected by SO12.
events.uncertainty: Do not treat the apparent Dionysus death as final historical truth. TL-0386 records Penia’s actual return underlying this mistaken contemporary account, not an additional death.

events.title: Penia’s death seals the converted followers’ Statuses during the first assault
events.when: During SO11’s first major assault; truth explained during SO12’s final operation.
events.changes: Dionysus kills the restrained Penia, whose return seals her converted followers’ abilities. Aura and the others are wiped out; Dionysus survives and conceals himself.
events.knowledge: Contemporary observers mistake the pillar and seal for Dionysus’s return. Loki later reconstructs the substitution.
events.uncertainty: No contemporaneous general knowledge of Penia’s role. The fate of each follower is not assigned an individually witnessed final blow.
events.frame: SO12 retrospective correction of SO11 apparent death

events.title: Lefiya’s delayed Level Four promotion is completed
events.when: SO12 before the final counterattack.
events.changes: Lefiya becomes Level Four with a new skill; she had qualified on Floor 59.
events.knowledge: Latest update changes her actual capabilities now.

events.title: Lilly is Level Two; Haruhime’s promotion is withheld
events.when: FM15 post-expedition updates.
events.changes: Lilly promoted; Haruhime remains Level One despite qualifying.
events.knowledge: Haruhime and Lilly are not told of Haruhime’s eligibility; Bell, Hestia, Welf and Aisha discuss it.

events.title: Bell fulfills his promise to hear Lyu’s Familia story
events.when: After recovery from Floor 37, at the tavern.
events.changes: Bell and Lyu spend time together after her ordeal. Bell and Lyu later eat Mia’s risotto, fulfilling their deep-floor warm-meal promise.
events.knowledge: Bell sought to learn about her old Familia; do not assume he receives every private AR conversation.
events.uncertainty: Only the conversation’s stated scope is supported, not exhaustive historical knowledge. Bell offers a story in exchange for the meal, but this passage does not enumerate every detail actually told to Mia.

events.title: Eina and Hestia compare Bell’s reports after the deep-floor ordeal
events.when: After Bell returns from the deep floors and reports his experiences; exact evening unknown.
events.changes: Hestia and Eina discuss their worry over Bell at a bar; Eina cannot remember her own drunken remarks the next morning.
events.knowledge: Both have heard Bell’s account, including his claimed eight near-death experiences. That does not establish disclosure of every private Floor 37 detail.
events.uncertainty: The near-death number is Bell’s reported characterization, not a complete medically defined injury count.
events.frame: SS01 Whenever the Adviser and the Loli-Goddess Drink

events.title: Welf gains Veritas Burn after the expedition
events.when: Post-expedition Status review in FM15.
events.changes: Veritas Burn appears; Welf remains Level Two.
events.uncertainty: Do not backdate the skill to forging Shikou Kazuki in the Dungeon.

events.title: Hestia withholds Mikoto’s potential self-destruction skill
events.when: FM15 post-expedition Status discussion.
events.changes: Mikoto does not gain the potential skill.
events.knowledge: The deity’s awareness of eligibility is not an active ability possessed by Mikoto.
events.uncertainty: No exact calendar date or exhaustive participant knowledge asserted.

events.title: Finn secretly supplies material for Lilly’s new crossbow
events.when: After Lilly’s Level Two update and her recent crossbow order; before completion of the newly named weapon.
events.changes: Finn authorizes leftover oathtree walnut for Lilly’s Sciurus’s Walnut; his Fortia Spear has been repaired.
events.knowledge: Goibniu tells Finn of Lilly’s promotion. Lilly does not know the material’s benefactor; Goibniu does not know the past marriage proposal.
events.uncertainty: Commissioning and material allocation are not a confirmed delivery date. No exact placement relative to Bell’s recovery or Knossos is established.
events.frame: SS01 At the Blacksmith’s: What She Didn’t Know

events.title: Bell tells the Loki women the Spirits’ Six-Ring story
events.when: During preparations to counter the six-spirit threat, before the second great assault.
events.changes: The women treat Bell’s story as a crucial clue and leave to report to Finn; Tiona thanks him.
events.knowledge: Bell and Lilly do not understand the purpose of the inquiry. Bell guesses an adventure, not the whole Knossos plan.
events.uncertainty: The story is a clue, not proof Bell knows all contemporary enemy mechanisms. Their intended report is not itself shown being delivered in this passage.
events.frame: SS02 To the One I Met Upon a Story’s Page

events.title: Bell’s arm remains immobilized before full recovery
events.when: FM15 opening to later return to regular Dungeon activity.
events.changes: Early cast and sling restrict use; later text expressly says the arm is fully healed. The post-awakening hospital meal also explicitly shows the left arm unusable.
events.uncertainty: Do not place full recovery at hospital awakening or assign an exact healing day.

events.title: Aiz discloses her secret Ottar training to Riveria
events.when: Eve of the second Knossos assault; training began before the first.
events.changes: Training predates the disclosure. Riveria agrees to let Aiz face Levis; both are assigned to unit two. She reports hearing stat increases above 250 apiece, not a new level.
events.knowledge: Riveria learns of the secret training now; do not backdate her knowledge.
events.frame: Current pre-assault conversation with retrospective explanation

events.title: Finn tells Tione his changed aspiration toward Fianna
events.when: Night before the second Knossos assault.
events.changes: Finn has sworn to become a brighter beacon than Fianna; five units are ready to deploy.
events.knowledge: Tione hears this change directly and reaffirms her love.
events.uncertainty: This conversation attests and discloses the outlook; it does not date its first formation or establish a mutual romantic commitment.

events.title: Gareth and Rakuta discover Bete visiting Leene’s grave
events.when: Eve of the second great Knossos assault.
events.changes: Bete is equipped with Frosvirt and Dual Roland and visits the fallen comrades’ graves.
events.knowledge: Gareth and Rakuta see the visit; Bete demands secrecy. Rakuta voices confidence in victory, which he echoes.
events.uncertainty: Equipment presence does not date acquisition; no universal public disclosure of Bete’s private mourning.
events.frame: SS02 In Place of Flowers, the Wolf Howls

events.title: Enyo is exposed as Dionysus; Filvis is identified with Ein
events.when: SO12 final assault revelations.
events.changes: The apparent deaths and conspiracy must be reinterpreted.
events.knowledge: Loki had warned Lefiya of a hypothesis before the operation; battlefield confirmation follows. Readers learn Dionysus’s identity, but not every combatant is in his room.
events.uncertainty: Final fates are separately recorded in TL-0105; witnesses differ by room.

events.title: Hermes rejects Demeter’s false confession and hears the hostage account
events.when: During the final SO12 operation, in the separate mountainside conversation.
events.changes: Demeter abandons her insistence that she is Enyo and tells Hermes why she complied with the actual mastermind.
events.knowledge: Hermes hears the capture and murders. This scene is separate from Loki’s chamber and Lefiya’s battlefield; knowledge is not automatically shared between them in real time.
events.uncertainty: The quoted recollection of Takemikazuchi’s concern is not a claim he knew the hostage situation. No minute-by-minute order relative to the other confessions.

events.title: Filvis reveals her past and explains her wish to protect Lefiya
events.when: After Ein is unmasked during the final SO12 assault; before the closing battle.
events.changes: Filvis explains the Nightmare, transformation, concealed spell and relationship with Dionysus. She admits that Lefiya’s acceptance changed her and inspired protective actions; she still refuses Lefiya’s appeal to join her.
events.knowledge: The present listeners learn the history now. Earlier affection did not mean Lefiya knew the secret or Filvis had already defected. Loki hears Dionysus’s account separately.
events.uncertainty: No completed redemption, alliance switch or universal audience. Do not project this knowledge back onto their earlier training or rescue scenes.
events.frame: SO12 battlefield disclosure of prior history and motives

events.title: The reserve teams rescue Demeter’s surviving followers from Knossos
events.when: During the final SO12 assault, after the rescue is planned and before Nidhogg’s defeat.
events.changes: The teams find imprisoned, emaciated hostages on the ninth and tenth floors. Rei helps locate hidden rooms. Rescuers provide first aid and evacuate survivors, reserving full treatment for outside.
events.knowledge: Elfie recognizes the plea she overlooked during the prior assault. The plan had followed Loki’s identification of Dionysus and Demeter’s situation; it does not depend on overhearing Hermes’s simultaneous confession.
events.uncertainty: Not all hostages survive, and rescue is not full physical or psychological recovery. No exhaustive survivor count or universal disclosure of Xenos identity.
events.frame: SO12 current rescue with earlier planning recalled

events.title: Bell and Aiz end the Nidhogg and Revis battles
events.when: The decisive blows occur at the same time in SO12.
events.changes: Revis is destroyed; Nidhogg obliterated; Aiz wounded and Bell exhausted.
events.knowledge: Raul witnesses Bell’s victory. This does not mean Bell hears Loki’s separate Enyo interrogation.

events.title: Dionysus returns to heaven; both Filvis bodies disappear
events.when: SO12 ending, after the seven spirits are defeated.
events.changes: One Filvis goes to Dionysus; the other says farewell to Lefiya. Both cease their bodily existence.
events.knowledge: Lefiya hears her own farewell, not automatically the separate conversation in Loki’s chamber.
events.uncertainty: Narrative intercutting does not establish a minute-by-minute order between farewells.

events.title: Knossos casualties are mourned; survivors’ levels change
events.when: SO13 opening after clearing Knossos.
events.changes: Anakity reaches Level Five; several named members Level Four; Raul, Alicia, Cruz and Narfi do not rank up in this update.
events.knowledge: Funerals do not mean every detail of the hidden battle became public.
events.uncertainty: Not an exhaustive casualty or rank-up roster.

events.title: Loki privately updates her three leaders to Level Seven
events.when: After their qualifying feats and before the delayed public announcement; exact update day unknown.
events.changes: The trio has reached Level Seven before Aiz learns of it.
events.knowledge: Loki withholds the news; Aiz explicitly did not realize they had leveled up.
events.uncertainty: This interval must not be collapsed to the announcement date.
events.frame: SO14 celebration recalls the concealed update

events.title: Lefiya collects new gear and appears with cut hair after Knossos
events.when: Some time after Enyo’s defeat, before her new training regime; gear collected that morning.
events.changes: Lefiya collects commissioned magic-resistant clothing and new casting weapons, carries a shortsword and has cut her hair. She apologizes for missing the communal breakfast without effective notice.
events.knowledge: The gathered Familia sees the change. Aiz’s interpretation of the colors as Filvis’s legacy is her perspective, not a new spell or complete explanation spoken to everyone.
events.uncertainty: Appearance and new equipment do not prove recovery from grief or mastery of sword combat.

events.title: Lefiya persuades Bete to train her; their seventh day shows her limits
events.when: Agreement and first training on the gear-collection day; a subsequent scene is their seventh training day.
events.changes: Lefiya seeks close-range instruction while retaining Riveria as her teacher. She offers bombardment practice to test Bete’s reworked Frosvirt. Training starts that day; on day seven she still struggles to defend and cast while wielding her friend’s sword.
events.knowledge: Familia witnesses hear the agreement. Training demonstrates an aspiration and limitations, not instant attainment of Filvis’s combat proficiency.
events.uncertainty: The record spans a week of training, not seven days after Enyo’s defeat. Bete accepting this arrangement does not imply universal gentleness or a permanent change of personality.

events.title: Bell hears about the Great Conflict at its memorial
events.when: Seven-year memorial day; precise alignment with FM arcs unresolved here.
events.changes: Bell encounters mourning customs and receives historical context.
events.knowledge: He already heard of the Age of Darkness from Eina and Lilly; Hermes expands that knowledge.
events.uncertainty: Do not identify this memorial with every other named remembrance day without an additional synchronizing anchor.
events.frame: AR01 contemporary prologue, not an event during the Great Conflict

events.title: Bogan tells Bell he returned the stolen armor and rebuilt his life
events.when: Seven-year memorial outing with Hermes; restitution and later purchase happened sometime between the conflict and this conversation.
events.changes: Bogan wears the armor he once stole, reports returning it and later saving enough to buy it, and pays respects at a girl’s grave. Bell promises to honor those who came before him.
events.knowledge: Bell learns that Bogan was a thief who reformed; he does not recognize the buried people personally. The reader can connect this to the earlier forgiveness scene, but Bell is not told every detail of Lyu’s role here.
events.uncertainty: Exact dates of return, purchase and career change are unknown. Bell is called upper-class, which supplies a broad state but not an exact main-arc date.
events.frame: AR03 contemporary memorial with Bogan’s intervening history reported

events.title: Hermes gives Bell only a bounded account of the Astrea losses
events.when: AR03 memorial continuation after the AR01 prologue frame.
events.changes: Bell asks after Lyu’s Familia.
events.knowledge: Hermes describes their later deaths, mentions Alfia, then deflects Bell’s question; Bell is not told the private ancestry secret.
events.uncertainty: Hermes says “shortly after”; the independently established seven-year conflict/five-year destruction gives an approximately two-year gap. Preserve the loose wording.

events.title: Hedin engineers Laurier’s rescue as Bell’s date-training exercise
events.when: Three days before the Goddess Festival, after forty-eight hours of Hedin’s training.
events.changes: Hedin creates a monster swarm. Bell rescues the injured Laurier, lends his coat and escorts her to the upper-floor passage. He accepts a vague future shopping invitation; Hedin takes him away.
events.knowledge: Bell knows Hedin engineered the danger; Laurier does not learn this and misreads the pressured behavior as courtship. Hermes’s later reaction is a separate undated narrator aside.
events.uncertainty: Laurier is explicitly Level Two at line 5149 but calls herself second-tier at 5231; preserve the terminology conflict without promoting her. Her injury has no specified complete recovery time. No completed shopping date is shown.
events.frame: SS01 Is it Wrong to Fake an Accident…, present rescue with retrospective intelligence work and later-reaction coda

events.title: Hedin makes Bell practice escorting in Rivira; Cassandra mistakes it for a date
events.when: Day before the Goddess Festival, recalled while Cassandra works at the festival stall.
events.changes: Bell shops with Cassandra during Hedin’s secret training; Cassandra is delighted by the outing.
events.knowledge: Cassandra does not know Hedin orchestrated it or that Bell practiced with other women.
events.uncertainty: Cassandra’s belief it was a date is not an agreed romantic commitment. Her dream’s meaning is her speculation.
events.frame: SS01 Eyewitness Account: The Prophet, festival frame recalling yesterday

events.title: Syr’s date and Hörn’s impersonation occupy different festival days
events.when: First and second days of the Goddess Festival.
events.changes: Hörn’s attempt fails and she is severely injured.
events.knowledge: Readers and confronting Freya executives learn the impersonation distinction; Bell has already left this scene. First-day observers include Lyu, Anya, Runoa, Chloe, Eina, Misha and the Miach stall group. Seeing the date is not learning the Syr/Horn distinction; Lyu’s Floor 37 recollection stays private.

events.title: Tiona and Tione clash with Syr’s escorts during the festival date
events.when: During Bell and Syr’s first-day festival outing.
events.changes: Tiona tries to approach Bell; the escorts intervene, a brawl involves Tione, and the five lose sight of Syr. Aisha separately heads toward an escort encounter.
events.knowledge: Their interventions do not reveal Syr’s divine identity to the twins or Aisha. The brothers’ possible conversation is expressly hedged by the narrator.
events.uncertainty: Do not infer an escort-free remainder of the whole day or make the hedged dialogue a confirmed exchange.
events.frame: SS01 Eyewitness Account: The Amazon and The Berbera, parallel observer vignettes

events.title: Freya’s altered Orario begins on the festival’s third day
events.when: Third day of Goddess Festival; FM17 captivity follows.
events.changes: City memories manipulated; Bell held by Freya Familia.
events.knowledge: Hestia resists. Ouranos is not charmed; deep-floor absentees require separate handling. Do not treat every person everywhere as affected.

events.title: Lyu recovers outside Orario and returns with Asfi to observe
events.when: Almost a whole day unconscious in Agris; approach to Orario on the morning of the third day after the Festival.
events.changes: Lyu is treated and mobile enough to travel with Asfi; both initially stay outside the city.
events.knowledge: Asfi’s report of the attack is explicitly limited to what she knows.
events.uncertainty: No exact calendar date or exhaustive participant knowledge asserted.

events.title: Freya updates Bell without converting him
events.when: FM17 captivity.
events.changes: Bell still bears Hestia’s Falna; Status Snitch enables another deity’s update.
events.knowledge: Freya knows the trick; Bell’s confidence is being undermined.

events.title: Lilly feels the missing place in her party under Freya’s charm
events.when: After the Goddess Festival, during the altered-city interval and before charm release.
events.changes: The four prepare for the Dungeon without Bell; Lilly questions their composition and cries without understanding why.
events.knowledge: Lilly experiences fragments associated with Bell but does not recover his identity or understand the alteration. The companions see distress, not a demonstrated recovery of memory.
events.uncertainty: No exact day or successful expedition to Floor 18 is established; that destination is a plan.

events.title: Freya fabricates Bell’s recruitment history using Eina’s journal
events.when: Early captivity; the journal was taken the previous day.
events.changes: Bell’s confidence is undermined by plausible details.
events.knowledge: Freya knows the journal and Syr memories are her sources; Bell does not. The earlier recruitment she describes did not happen.
events.uncertainty: No exact calendar date or exhaustive participant knowledge asserted.
events.frame: Present-day false account with narrative exposure of the deception

events.title: Hephaistos suspects manipulated memory but cannot recall the Hestia Knife
events.when: During Freya’s altered city, when Hestia has missed seven consecutive workdays.
events.changes: Hephaistos confronts Hestia over the missing weapon memory and absences; Hestia feigns ignorance under surveillance.
events.knowledge: Hephaistos suspects outside interference but cannot identify the forgotten weapon. Hestia’s evasiveness is coerced, not proof that she too has forgotten.
events.uncertainty: Half a year is approximate and is not converted into days; no change to the knife’s Falna mechanism is asserted.
events.frame: SS01 Looking for a Love Dagger

events.title: Bell undergoes the baptism and Hedin intensifies it
events.when: Begins the morning after Freya’s curse story to the Familia; Hedin’s escalation continues over successive days.
events.changes: Bell is subjected to repeated live combat while remaining a Hestia follower.
events.knowledge: The captors’ curse story is not a real explanation of Bell’s memories.
events.uncertainty: No exact calendar date or exhaustive participant knowledge asserted.

events.title: Tiona cannot understand her sense of loss under the charm
events.when: During Freya’s altered-city interval, before release.
events.changes: Tiona rereads Argonaut and feels an unexplained loss of the hero she wanted to support.
events.knowledge: The silver gleam twists recognition; her loneliness does not amount to knowing Bell’s true place or Freya’s scheme.
events.uncertainty: Her self-comparison with a princess is private thought, not a universal personality rule or an established romantic commitment.
events.frame: SS01 Because All She Wanted Was to Watch Over Him Forever

events.title: Heith gives Bell a false explanation for Hörn’s enforced absence
events.when: During Bell’s captivity in Freya’s altered Orario; before Hörn’s later approach to him.
events.changes: Hörn obeys an order to stay out of Bell’s sight. Heith covers her absence with an invented embarrassing encounter.
events.knowledge: Bell does not know the prohibition. Freya has told the other chamberlains what Hörn did; Heith knows her special connection to Freya. The narration does not enumerate every detail each chamberlain received.
events.uncertainty: Heith’s fondness is not an intention to compete romantically with Freya. No actual changing-room encounter is established.
events.frame: SS01 Syr and Hörn: The Space in Between, captivity frame

events.title: Freya reveals her Syr identity to Anya
events.when: FM17, before Bell’s later realization.
events.changes: Anya is emotionally devastated by the revelation.
events.knowledge: Anya receives a direct identity disclosure; her prior friendship does not imply prior knowledge.

events.title: Lyu learns Freya was Syr and is hidden underground
events.when: After the Anya confrontation; before a week of underground confinement.
events.changes: Lyu loses consciousness after temporary charm and is carried away.
events.knowledge: Freya directly tells Lyu she was the Syr who spent time with her.
events.uncertainty: Freya releases the charm; imprisonment is not acceptance of false memories.

events.title: Asfi’s observation and Hermes’s recovered note support the hearth plan
events.when: Plan recovered three days after Asfi’s observation and three days before Bell lands a blow on the elf.
events.changes: Hermes resumes work from the written instructions despite memory interference.
events.knowledge: Hestia hears Asfi’s interpretation; Hermes receives his prior self’s plan.
events.uncertainty: Retrieval of the plan is not the first instant of Hermes’s suspicion.

events.title: Bell suspects Freya’s charm after recovering confidence in his identity
events.when: Before Hörn supplies the Syr identity clue.
events.changes: Bell is certain he is not Freya’s follower.
events.knowledge: He suspects charm as the best explanation but still does not know why he alone resists or its full mechanism.
events.uncertainty: The inferred explanation is Bell’s; not every resident is affected.

events.title: Hörn privately recognizes her own feelings and resolves to serve Freya
events.when: Later in the same captivity sequence, after Heith challenges Hörn about her behavior.
events.changes: Hörn distinguishes watching Bell herself from sharing Freya’s viewpoint, struggles with her own feelings and resolves to devote them to her goddess.
events.knowledge: Hörn senses Freya’s suffering and activates her magic for deeper contact. Hedin interrupts; this does not show he hears every private thought. Bell is absent from the decision.
events.uncertainty: The explanation of her eye and magic recalls earlier acquisition; neither is acquired during this scene. Her decision is not yet a disclosure to Bell.
events.frame: SS01 Syr and Hörn: The Space in Between, private progression with earlier-blessing explanation

events.title: Bell understands the Syr/Freya connection through Hörn
events.when: FM17 later captivity sequence.
events.changes: Bell can interpret the vanished Syr and Freya’s conduct together.
events.knowledge: Bell reaches the identity conclusion here; distinguish this from the reader’s earlier revelation.

events.title: Hestia’s bells survive the erasure of Bell’s place in her life
events.when: During Freya’s citywide charm.
events.changes: Hestia retains the earlier gift and uses its personal meaning.
events.knowledge: Freya did not know this gift memory; Hestia still does. Hestia describes the gift’s importance without naming Bell as giver because of threats to her followers. Bell’s question does not establish full restored confidence or recognition; the scene increases his watchers’ suspicions.
events.frame: Current charm scene recalls a pre-Syr-meeting gift

events.title: Hestia’s hearth breaks the citywide charm
events.when: FM17 climax.
events.changes: Manipulated residents recover awareness of what happened; open confrontation becomes possible.
events.knowledge: Released residents recognize false memories; this is not proof each learns every Freya secret.

events.title: Lyu escapes her restraints but is cornered before Aiz intervenes
events.when: A week after awakening underground; the struggle continues until Aiz’s post-charm intervention.
events.changes: Lyu regains weapons and magic, fights through the manor, and is cornered; Aiz blocks Hegni’s attack.
events.knowledge: Lyu confirms Folkvangr during escape, not necessarily when first waking.
events.uncertainty: This record spans an escape attempt and later rescue. The beginning precedes the charm breaking; only the intervention follows it.

events.title: Bell reaches Level Five
events.when: FM18 before the Great Faction War.
events.changes: Level Five; Rapid Attacks and charm-conditioned Vanadis Tevere shown.
events.knowledge: Bell learns the new displayed abilities.
events.uncertainty: Vanadis recovery is conditional on the stated Charm effect; not generic wound regeneration.

events.title: The Freya War Game rules are announced with a six-day countdown
events.when: Six days before the scheduled game.
events.changes: Hide-and-seek at Orza is announced; Loki Familia will not participate.
events.knowledge: The nonparticipation announcement does not reveal every private reason.
events.uncertainty: No exact calendar date or exhaustive participant knowledge asserted.

events.title: Haruhime’s Level Two and stronger boost are confirmed in prewar training
events.when: After FM15’s withheld promotion, by the final days of Bell’s prewar tuning.
events.changes: Haruhime is Two: twenty-minute boost, nine-minute cooldown, maximum six tails.
events.knowledge: Training participants witness the improved effect.
events.uncertainty: Actual promotion date unknown; does not need to follow Bell’s Five update simply because he mentions it here.

events.title: Lyu visits Astrea and receives staged updates
events.when: FC03 The Locus of Stars, after the Freya war is announced and before Lyu enters it.
events.changes: Lyu advances first to Five, then Six after adjustment; Astrea Record appears.
events.knowledge: Astrea explains withheld excelia to Lyu; spectators learn later at TL-0049.
events.uncertainty: Visit’s exact global date remains unknown; training and adaptation cannot be removed from the sequence. SS01 supplies Astrea’s side of the reunion opening; “new family” in her thoughts is not evidence of an already-completed Hestia conversion. Local arrival day is Solingen Day 1 only. TL-0257–TL-0268 distinguish travel, staged updates, disclosures, adjustment, equipment and departure within and after this aggregate record.

events.title: Lyu leaves Orario with Asfi’s signal item and Bors’s recovered fragment
events.when: Before dawn after the war is announced; before the local Solingen arrival day.
events.changes: Lyu travels east, rescues a caravan and rests with it overnight; Hermes’s map and passage papers enable the journey. She carries a broken Alvs Lumina fragment and an emergency signal item.
